Paragraf: Penelitian variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya dilatarbelakangi fenomena bahasa tulis yang terdapat di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya. Adanya variasi bahasa tidak menghilangkan fungsi dari lanskap linguistik. Lanskap linguistik memberikan informasi kepada wisatawan yang berkunjung ke Candi Mendut. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk (1) menemukan bentuk variasi bahasa kajian lanskap linguistik di sekitar Candi Mendut, dan (2) menemukan fungsi lanskap linguistik di sekitar Candi Mendut. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan tipe deskriptif. Data penelitian berupa kata, frasa, klausa, dan wacana. Pengumpulan data menggunakan teknik observasi dan dokumentasi. Adapun analisis data menggunakan teknik Bagi Unsur Langsung (BUL). Hasil penelitian ditemukan variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya berupa monolingualisme, bilingualisme, dan multilingualisme. Adapun fungsi lanskap linguistik yang ditemukan berupa fungsi informasi dan fungsi simbolis. Berdasarkan hasil penelitian, variasi bahasa pada lanskap linguistik yang paling banyak digunakan di Candi Mendut dan sekitarnya ialah bentuk variasi bilingualisme bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris. Fungsi lanskap linguistik yang ditemukan berupa fungsi informasi yang meliputi larangan, imbauan, petunjuk arah, dan nama tempat. Fungsi simbolis meliputi relasi kebudayaan, relasi politik, dan relasi ekonomi.
Judul: SKRIPSI VARIASI BAHASA PADA LANSKAP DI SEKITAR CANDI MENDUT
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Candi Mendut, fungsi lanskap linguistik, variasi bahasa

Paragraf: Sambungan dalam dunia industri digunakan untuk menggabungkan dua material atau lebih. Sambungan mekanik dilakukan dengan berbagai metode yaitu,pengelasan, rivet, baut dan adhesive bonding (perekat). Sambungan perekat merupakan salah satu metode yang efektif dalam membuat ikatan dua suatu material. Metode ini lebih efektif dibandingkan dengan metode penyambungan yang lain seperti sambungan paku keling, sambungan las dan sambungan baut. ketika terjadi kerusakan, mudah korosi, harus dilakukannya perawatan khusus. Kebutuhan industri menuntut untuk mendapatkan sambungan yang kuat dan ekonomis mendorong banyak peneliti untuk mendapatkan metode alternatif. Penggunaan adhesive menjadi alternatif dalam rekayasa yang menghasilkan struktur yang ringan. Adhesive bonding adalah proses penyatuan dua permukaan dengan menciptakan ikatan yang halus. Adapun akan akan dilakukan penelitian peningkatan kekuatan mekanik sambungan tumpang tunggal dengan mixed adhesive – getah pinus dengan variasi campuran 100 % : 0 % , 90% : 10%, 80 % : 20 % , 75 % : 25 % pada similar material baja ST 37. Pengujian tarik dari variasi campuran a, b, c dan d mengalami peningkatan maximum force. Sedangkan untuk kekuatan tarik mengalami penurunan yang signifikan dimana kekuatan tarik variasi 100% EP : 0 % GP sebesar 0,263 Mpa, untuk variasi ini mendapatkan nilai yang tertinggi dan kekuatan Tarik dengan nilai terendah dihasilkan pada variasi 70 % EP : 30 % GP dengan nilai 0,0092 Mpa.
Judul: SKRIPSI KARAKTERISTIK KEKUATAN MEKANIK SAMBUNGAN TUMPANG TUNGGAL DENGAN MIXED ADHESIVE PADA SIMILAR MATERIAL BAJA ST 37
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci : adhesive bonding, Baja ST 37, Uji Tarik.

Paragraf: Sumber Energi Terbarukan (EBT) harus lah dapat dimanfaatkan dengan baik, sebagai upaya untuk mengurangi krisis energi dan dampak polusi. Salah satunya dengan mengembangkan Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Mikro Hidro (PLTMH). Jenis turbin yang yang berpotensi untuk pembuatan PLTMH pada sungai-sungai di Indonesia yaitu turbin ulir. Tujuan dari penilitian ini yaitu untuk mengetahui performa dari turbin ulir dengan menggunakan variasi sudut kemiringan poros turbin dengan variasi sudutnya yaitu 32°, 36°, 40° dan 44°. Hasil penilitian ini menunjukan bahwa sudut kemiringan poros turbin dapat mempengaruhi kinerja turbin ulir. Hasi yang diperoleh menunujukan kemiringan poros turbin dengan sudut 32° mendapatkan performa yang maksimal dengan nilai torsi sebesar 0,930 Nm, daya yang dihasilkan yaitu 33,085 Watt, dan efisiensinya yaitu 87%. Untuk hasil terendah didapatkan pada variasi sudut 44° dengan torsi yang diahsilkan yaitu 0,702 Nm , daya sebesar 23,034 Watt dan efisiensinya 51%. Renewable Energy Sources (EBT) must be utilized properly, as an effort to reduce the energy crisis and the impact of pollution. One of his effort can be done is developing a Micro Hydro Power Plant (MHP). The type of turbine that has the potential for making MHP on rivers in Indonesia is the screw turbine. The aim of this research is to determine the performance of a screw turbine using variations in the tilt angle of the turbine shaft with variations the angles are 32°, 36°, 40° and 44°. The results of this research show that the inclination angle of the turbine shaft can affect the performance of the screw turbine. The results obtained show that tilting the turbine shaft at an angle of 32° achieves maximum performance with a torque value of 0.930 Nm, the power produced is 33.085 Watts, and the efficiency is 87%. The lowest results were obtained at a 44° angle variation with the resulting torque being 0.702 Nm, power of 23.034 Watts and efficiency of 51%.
Judul: SKRIPSI KAJI EKSPERIMENTAL PENGARUH VARIASI SUDUT KEMIRINGAN POROS TERHADAP EFISIENSI PADA TURBIN ULIR TIPE DOUBLE BLADE
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: archimedes screw, EBT, PLTMH, turbin ulir. | Keywords:archimedes screw, MHP, renewable energy, screw turbine.

Paragraf: Pakan ternak dibutuhkan oleh semua jenis hewan ruminansia. Adanya alat pembuat pakan permen ternak otomatis yang belum mempunyai nilai tekanan menjadi permasalahan dalam memperoleh kualitas permen ternak yang diinginkan. Tujuan dari penelitian ini adalah meningkatkan produktivitas pembuatan permen ternak melalui pengaruh variasi tekanan terhadap kapasitas mesin prees pneumatik yang dihasilkan, serta densitas dan kadar air yang dihasilkan dari variasi tekanan pengepresan. Metode penelitian yang digunakan antara lain : Studi Literatur, Metode Observasi Lapangan, Bimbingan, Analisis. Variasi tekanan yang digunakan pada setiap pengepresan pada alat ini adalah 6 kgf/cm2, 8 kgf/cm2, dan 10 kgf/cm2. Motor listrik pada kompresor yang digunakan mempunyai daya sebesar 2 HP dengan putaran mesin 2800 rpm. Hasil penelitian ini adalah dari ketiga variasi tersebut yang menghasilkan massa jenis pada saat pengepresan adalah variasi tekanan sebesar 10 kgf/cm2 dengan massa jenis rata-rata sebesar 0,861 gr/cm3. Waktu pengerjaan selama satu siklus pada proses pengepresan menunjukkan bahwa 1 produk permen ternak membutuhkan waktu 2 menit.
Judul: SKRIPSI RANCANG BANGUN MESIN PRESS OTOMATIS KONSENTRAT PERMEN TERNAK BERBASIS SISTEM PNEUMATIK
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : Pengepresan, Permen ternak, Pneumatik, Produktivitas, Variasi Tekanan

Paragraf: Beban listrik merupakan kebutuhan energi listrik yang besarnya tidak tetap dan dipengaruhi oleh banyak faktor yang sulit diprediksi. Oleh karena itu, produsen listrik perlu memprediksi permintaan listrik konsumen untuk masa mendatang. Salah satu metode yang digunakan adalah jaringan saraf tiruan dengan algoritma backpropagation. Karena sanggup melakukan pembelajaran terhadap pola yang diberikan sebagai contoh. Variabel yang digunakan merupakan data jumlah penduduk dan data Produk Domestik Regional Bruto (PDRB) yang diperoleh dari website resmi BPS Kabupaten Cilacap serta data jumlah pelanggan, daya tersambung, dan konsumsi daya listrik yang diperoleh dari PT. PLN (Persero) UP3 Kabupaten Cilacap. Dalam penelitian ini, menggunakan tiga variasi pada jumlah neuron hidden layer, max.epoch, dan learning rate untuk menentukan model jaringan terbaik yang digunakan untuk peramalan. Hasil dari tahap peltihan dan tahap pengujian menentukan model arsitektur jaringan yang optimal untuk tahap selanjutnya yaitu peramalan. Hal ini dapat dilihat dari rata-rata nilai error atau MAPE yang diperoleh dari perbandingan output JST backpropagation dengan target sesungguhnya yaitu jaringan dengan kriteria traingdx 4 input – 37 neuron hidden layer – 1 output, max.epoch 10000, dan 0.01 untuk learning ratenya. Hasil dari tahap pelatihan memperoleh nilai rata-rata error MSE dan MAPE sebesar 0.00099999 dan 5.44%. Selain itu, terdapat nilai regresi yang didapatkan pada saat proses pelatihan sebesar 0.98226. Sedangkan pada hasil pengujian menghasilkan MSE dan MAPE sebesar 0.00009493 dan 3.99%, serta regresi sebesar 0.90709. Kesimpulan dari penelitian ini dimana penggunaan metode JST backpropagation untuk peramalan beban listrik Kabupaten Cilacap periode 2023-2030 yang menggunakan arsitektur dan parameter yang telah ditentukan jika dilihat kriteria nilai MAPE memiliki akurasi sangat baik untuk melakukan peramalan dan masih dibawah toleransi PLN yakni ≤ 10%.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERAMALAN BEBAN LISTRIK KABUPATEN CILACAP
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: backpropagation, beban listrik, jaringan syaraf tiruan, peramalan beban.

Paragraf: Dampak kebakaran bisa sangat merugikan dan berkisar dari kerusakan properti hingga konsekuensi yang mengancam jiwa. Umumnya, ketika terjadi kebakaran, pemadam kebakaran segera diberitahu. Namun keterlambatan untuk tiba di lokasi kebakaran sering kali disebabkan oleh jarak dan faktor lainnya. Saat ini belum ada alat pemadam kebakaran otomatis yang dipasang di Gedung Fakultas Teknik 3. Oleh karena itu, untuk mengurangi kerugian akibat kebakaran, diperlukan suatu sistem yang dapat memberikan peringatan adanya kebakaran secara otomatis dan memadamkannya. Perencanaan ini dilakukan dengan tujuan untuk melengkapi sistem proteksi kebakaran yang ada pada gedung FT3. Perencanaan ini memberikan rekomendasi desain untuk membuat bangunan lebih aman dari risiko kebakaran dengan menganalisis karakteristik bangunan meliputi bentuk, luas, dan jumlah lantai serta mengidentifikasi potensi bahaya kebakaran. Metode analisis data dilakukan sesuai dengan standar NFPA untuk memastikan keandalan dan keselamatan sistem. Hasil pengamatan menunjukkan bahwa gedung FT3 termasuk dalam kategori Potensi Bahaya Kebakaran Rendah, artinya bahaya kebakaran terkonsentrasi di area dengan bahan mudah terbakar yang menghasilkan sedikit panas dan dalam kondisi kebakaran artinya api akan menyebar secara perlahan. Berdasarkan perhitungan sistem yang diusulkan, diperlukan pemasangan 67 detektor asap, 222 sprinkler, volume air 416,35 m3, dan tangki air berkapasitas 500 m3. Daya pompa yang dibutuhkan meliputi daya pompa hidrolik (HHP) sebesar 35,2 kW, daya poros pompa (BHP) sebesar 46,9 kW, daya pompa listrik (P) sebesar 60 kW, dan daya pompa diesel (PpD) sebesar 27 HP. Pompa Jockey (PJk) berkapasitas 6 kW dan kapasitas Ground Water Tank (QGWT) 500 m3. Total anggaran pembangunan sistem pemadam kebakaran otomatis di Gedung Fakultas Teknik 3 Universitas Tidar adalah senilai Rp 1.232.640.194 sesuai perkiraan perhitungan biaya. Peningkatan sistem keamanan gedung Fakultas Teknik 3 dapat menciptakan persepsi positif di kalangan mahasiswa, dosen, dan masyarakat umum. Ini dapat meningkatkan kepercayaan terhadap institusi dan menciptakan lingkungan belajar dan kerja yang lebih aman. Penting untuk melibatkan semua pihak terkait, termasuk pihak pengelola gedung dan otoritas setempat, dalam implementasi dan pemeliharaan sistem ini untuk memastikan kinerja sistem yang optimal seiring berjalannya waktu. Kata Kunci-Detektor, Ground Water Tank, Hidrolik, Kebakaran, Pompa, Sprinkler
Judul: SKRIPSI PERENCANAAN SISTEM FIRE ALARM SEMI-ADDRESSABLE DAN SPRINKLER PADA BANGUNAN GEDUNG FAKULTAS TEKNIK 3 UNIVERSITAS TIDAR

Paragraf: INTI SARI Permasalahan yang sering dialami oleh peternakan ayam petelur yaitu limbah gas ammonia yang disebabkan oleh kotoran ayam. Dampak negatif yang dihasilkan oleh gas ammonia dapat mengganggu pertumbuhan ayam petelur dan lingkungan sekitar peternakan. Dampak apabila kadar gas ammonia melebihi ambang batas 25 PPM yaitu mukosa mata, saluran pernapasan, perkembangbiakan bibit penyakit, sistem kekebalan, dan saluran reproduksi ternak. Solusi yang diperoleh dengan melakukan pemantauan kadar gas ammonia pada peternakan ayam petelur untuk meminimalisir pencemaran udara sehingga pertumbuhan ayam petelur tidak terganggu. Penelitian ini menggunakan IoT untuk memantau kadar gas ammonia pada peternakan ayam petelur yang tidak memiliki keterbatasan jarak. Penelitian ini membuat suatu sistem pemantauan gas ammonia jarak jauh yang terintegrasi telegram sebagai media pantau. Sensor ammonia MQ-137 dapat melakukan pembacaan niali PPM mulai dari 8-50 PPM. Nilai error paling besar yaitu 10% dengan nilai rata-rata error 4%. Dinyatakan berhasil apabila sensor memberikan nilai hasil yang konsisten. Pengaplikasian pada kandang peternakan ayam diperoleh nilai ammonia paling besar yaitu 5.95 PPM. Pemberitahuan bekerja dengan baik apabila kadar ammonia melebihi ambang batas, kurang dari ambang batas, dan kondisi hujan atau tidak hujan, maka akan mengirimkan pemberitahuan sebanyak 3 kali dengan delay 1 menit. Ketika pemberitahuan masuk akan muncul tombol permintaan untuk menyalakan kipas atau mematikan kipas. Alat dapat mengirim pemberitahuan dan mengontrol kipas tidak bergantung pada jarak selama alat dan telegram terhubung dengan internet. Kata kunci – Ammonia, Kipas, Pemberitahuan, Pemantauan, Telegram
Judul: SKRIPSI SISTEM MONITORING JARAK JAUH PADA PETERNAKAN KANDANG AYAM PETELUR TERINTEGRASI TELEGRAM

Paragraf: Infused water merupakan air mineral dengan tambahan potongan buah-buahan, sayursayuran, maupun herbal. Buah yang dibutuhkan pada pembuatan infused water relatif sedikit. Potongan buah yang tidak habis dalam sekali pembuatan infused water menjadi lebih cepat busuk sehingga dibutuhkan langkah-langkah pengawetan buah. Pengeringan merupakan cara paling umum untuk mengawetkan makanan. Pengeringan menggunakan dehydrator mampu menghasilkan buah kering dengan kualitas lebih baik dibanding pengeringan dengan penjemuran. Proses pengeringan buah membutuhkan suhu tertentu untuk menjaga kualitas buah kering yang dihasilkan. Kendali PID digunakan untuk mengatur dan menjaga kestabilan suhu pada ruang pengering dengan mengatur tegangan yang masuk ke pemanas. Parameter kendali PID dihitung menggunakan aturan penyepadanan PID Ziegler-Nichols dengan metode osilasi. Adapun parameter kendali yang didapat adalah Kp = 24, Ti = 147.5, dan Td = 36.875. Set point yang ditetapkan adalah 35°C, 50°C, dan 60°C. Sistem kendali suhu menghasilkan nilai steady state error berturutturut sebesar 0.11%, 0.10%, dan 0.6%. Pada set point 35°C nilai rise time yang dihasilkan adalah 90 detik dengan settling time 1350 detik. Pada set point 50°C rise time terdeteksi selama 250 detik dengan settling time pada 1400 detik. Pada set point 60°C rise time yang dihasilkan adalah 680 detik dengan settling time 3480 detik. Nilai rise time dan settling time pada sistem kendali ini dapat dipercepat dengan menambah kapasitas pemanas yang digunakan. Buah yang dikeringkan adalah lemon, buah naga, apel, dan nanas dengan kandungan air berada di bawah 20% pada keadaan kering.
Judul: SKRIPSI SISTEM KENDALI SUHU PADA PENGERING BUAH MENGGUNAKAN METODE PID
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: infused water, kendali PID, pengeringan, suhu

Paragraf: Pada saat ini pengukuran detak jantung dilakukan dengan oximeter atau dengan pengukuran manual yang dilakukan oleh tenaga medis. Pengukuran detak jantung atau denyut nadi menjadi salah satu cara untuk mengetahui keadaan tubuh seseorang sedang dalam kondisi sehat atau tidak. Pada oximeter biasanya hanya terdapat fitur pengukuran tekanan darah sistolik dan diastolik saja. Pada penelitian ini dilakukan perancangan sistem monitoring detak jantung dengan sensor pulse heart rate dan mikrokontroler arduino nano. Mikrokontroler yang digunakan yaitu arduino nano karena pada arduino nano terdapat pin yang sangat lengkap dan harganya terjangkau. Sistem ini mempunyai fitur penyimpanan hasil pengukuran sebanyak 5 data yang akan disimpa pada EEPROM. Selain itu, sistem ini juga menampilkan grafik real time pada pengukuran detak jantung dan terdapat pengelompokkan kategori BPM normal atau tidak normal berdasarkan umur serta jenis kelamin. Metode pengukuran dilakukan 2 pembanding yaitu dengan pengukuran manual dan oximeter merk Omron tipe HTM 7603 sebagai uji kalibrasi alat. Persentase error yang dihasilkan dari perhitungan yaitu pada pengukuran manual laki-laki sebesar 1,66% dan perempuan 3,05 % untuk rentan umur 3-10 tahun dan 2% pada kategori laki-laki dan perempuan berusia ≥18 tahun.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERENCANAAN SISTEM MONITORING DETAK JANTUNG DENGAN SENSOR PULSE HEART RATE PADA JARI TANGAN
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci : Arduino nano, Detak Jantung, Oximeter, Sensor Pulse Heart Rate

Paragraf: Perhitungan dan perencanaan sistem elektrikal dilakukan sesuai dengan peraturan dan standar yang berlaku. Bangunan gedung Dekanat Universitas Tidar di Mertoyudan merupakan bangunan dengan 7 lantai dengan luas bangunan tiap lantai yakni 512 m2. Penelitian ini bertujuan membahas mengenai perencanaan sistem elektrikal yang sesuai dengan peraturan dan pedoman agar dalam pengunaannya dapat digunakan sesuai dengan standar dan peraturan yang berlaku. Perencanaan sistem elektrikal nantinya diharapkan dapat menunjang berbagai aktivitas didalamnya. Perencanaan sistem elektrikal ini mencakup pencahayaan dan kotak kontak. Berdasarkan perhitungan diperoleh jumlah titik penchayaan sebanyak 485 titik dan kotak kontak sebanyak 496 titik. Beban sistem pencahayaan terbesar ialah 570 Watt untuk ruangan auditorium pada lantai 7 dengan menggunakan lampu berjenis Downlight dengan daya sebesar 19 Watt. Beban terkecil pada sistem pencahayaan dihasilkan sebesar 9 Watt pada ruang koridor 1 atau ruang panel pada tiap lantai dengan menggunakan lampu Downlight 9 Watt. Pada kotak kontak beban terbesar dihasilkan sebesar 18000 Watt pada ruang Tata Usaha Fakultas A pada lantai 1 dan untuk beban terkecil sebesar 200 Watt pada koridor 1 tiap lantai. Jumlah beban keseluruhan untuk bangunan gedung tersebut diperoleh 151.906 VA, sehingga untuk penyambungan langganan daya ke PLN sebesar 164 kVA dibutuhkan generator set dengan kapasitas 150 kVA. Anggaran biaya untuk perencanaan sistem elektrikal memerlukan total biaya senilai Rp1.666.695.580.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERENCANAAN SISTEM ELEKTRIKAL PADA GEDUNG DEKANAT UNIVERSITAS TIDAR DI MERTOYUDAN
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci : Perencanaan, Sistem elektrikal, Pencahayaan, Kotak Kontak

Paragraf: Durian merupakan salah satu buah yang tumbuh di Indonesia dan memiliki nilai ekonomi yang cukup tinggi. Produksi buah Durian akan mengalami penurunan kualitas jika pohonnya tidak sehat. Permasalahan yang dialami petani durian salah satunya adalah serangan penyakit terhadap daun sehingga mengganggu proses produksi buah. Penyakit yang sering menyerang daun durian adalah bercak daun dan hawar daun. Pendeteksian dini terhadap penyakit daun durian tersebut dapat dilakukan dengan memaksimalkan kemajuan teknologi saat ini. Penelitian ini memiliki tujuan untuk menerapkan teknologi kecerdasan buatan yang dapat membantu mengenali, mengamati serta mendeteksi penyakit pada tanaman durian secara efektif. Algoritma YOLO (you only look once) merupakan bagian dari sistem kecerdasan buatan digunakan dalam penelitian ini. Objek yang dideteksi dalam penelitian ini dibagi menjadi 3 kelas yaitu bercak daun, hawar daun, dan daun sehat. Proses penyusunan sistem memanfaatkan citra daun yang memiliki kelas tersebut dengan jumlah 300 gambar dan 25 gambar sebagai citra uji. Dari hasil training dataset menggunakan Google colab, nilai mAP tertinggi didapat pada epoch 100 yaitu sebesar 0.815. Model kemudian diuji dan mendapatkan nilai akurasi yang 85%, precision 91%, recall 92%, dan error 15%. Durian is one of the fruits that grows in Indonesia and has significant economic value. The production of Durian fruit will experience a decline in quality if the tree is not healthy. One of the challenges faced by durian farmers is the attack of diseases on the leaves, which disrupts the fruit production process. Diseases that frequently affect durian leaves include leaf spots and leaf blight. Early detection of these durian leaf diseases can be accomplished by maximizing current technological advancements. This study aims to apply artificial intelligence technology to assist in recognizing, observing, and effectively detecting diseases in durian plants. The YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm is a component of the artificial intelligence system used in this research. The objects detected in this study are categorized into three classes: leaf spots, leaf blight, and healthy leaves. The system development process utilizes leaf images with these categories, comprising 300 images for training and 25 images for testing. From the results of training the dataset using Google colab, the highest mAP value was achieved at epoch 100, amounting to 0.815. Subsequently, the model was tested and attained an accuracy of 85%, precision of 91%, recall of 92%, and an error rate of 15%.
Judul: SKRIPSI DETEKSI PENYAKIT DAUN DURIAN DENGAN ALGORITMA YOLO (YOU ONLY LOOK ONCE)
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : deteksi-objek, machine-learning, penyakit-daun-durian, YOLO | Keyword: durian-leaf-disease, machine-learning, object-detection, YOLO

Paragraf: PT. Capung Indah Abadi berlokasi di JL.Raya Magelang – Purworejo Km.12, Tanggulrejo, Tempuran, Kabupaten Magelang. Fokus utama perusahaan ini adalah memproduksi produk kesehatan yang terbuat dari bahan alami. Dalam melakukan perencanaan elektrikal harus sesuai dengan Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI) dan Persyaratan Umum Instalasi Listrik (PUIL) dan undang-undang kelistrikan lainya. Dalam penelitian ini, metode yang diterapkan yaitu melakukan pengukuran ruangan untuk mendapatkan denah, menyusun gambar diagram single line sebagai representasi visual, selanjutnya perhitungan kebutuhan pencahayaan, perhitungan ukuran penghantar dan pengaman, perhitungan pembagian beban, dan perhitungan rencana anggaran biaya. Hasil dari penelitian diperoleh total kebutuhan daya sebesar 105.280 VA, dengan kapasitas genset yang disarankan sebesar 110.000 VA. Dan nominal susut tegangan yang diperhitungkan telah dibawah nilai 4% atau sudah memenuhi standar dari PUIL. Anggaran biaya yang diperlukan untuk pemasangan instalasi, AC, dan Genset sebesar Rp.947.717.000,-. Kata kunci — Perencanaan Elektrikal, Industri, PUIL 2011.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERENCANAAN PEKERJAAN PENCAHAYAAN, TATA UDARA, DAN CADANGAN DAYA GEDUNG PRODUKSI 2 LANTAI PT. CAPUNG INDAH ABADI

Paragraf: Kualitas suatu rangkaian elektronik sangat bergantung pada kualitas Printed Circuit Board (PCB) yang mendukung operasinya. Namun, inspeksi manual terhadap kecacatan pada PCB memiliki keterbatasan dalam ketelitian dan waktu. Berdasarkan permasalahan tersebut maka penulis melakukan penelitian mengenai implementasi Machine Learning pada deteksi kecacatan pada PCB. Dalam pengaplikasiannya, algoritma machine learning yang digunakan yaitu algoritma objek deteksi You Look Only Once versi 5 (YOLOv5) yang merupakan pengembangan dari convolutional neural network. Penelitian ini difokuskan untuk membangun sebuah sistem yang dapat mengidentifikasi kecacatan pada PCB dengan algoritma YOLO versi 5. Data yang digunakan yaitu sebanyak 600 gambar yang terbagi menjadi 384 data latih, 96 data validasi dan 120 data uji. Terdapat jenis kecacatan PCB yaitu diantaranya berupa open circuit, missing hole, mouse bite, short, spur, dan spurious copper. Hasil penelitian tersebut menggunakan YOLOv5 menunjukkan nilai mean Average Precission (mAP) 95,5%. Selain itu dalam pengujian menggunakan 120 data uji model mampu mendapatkan nilai akurasi 93,81% , presisi 98,22%, recall 95,24%, error 6%, dan Mean Squared Error (MSE) 0,51.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMPLEMENTASI MACHINE LEARNING PADA DETEKSI KECACATAN PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: Printed Circuit Board, kecacatan, Machine Learning, convolutional neural network, YOLOv5

Paragraf: Tanaman stroberi merupakan tanaman yang dapat tumbuh optimal dengan kondisi lingkungan seperti di dataran tinggi. Kondisi lingkungan yang kurang baik dapat menyebabkan tanaman stroberi tumbuh kurang maksimal. Oleh karena itu, perlu adanya greenhouse untuk melindungi tanaman stroberi dari kondisi lingkungan yang kurang baik dan resiko serangan hama penyakit. Tujuan dari penelitian ini adalah merancang sistem kendali pada greenhouse tanaman stroberi. Sistem kendali pada greenhouse ini menggunakan fuzzy logic controller metode sugeno. Hasil pengujian sensor DHT22 memiliki rata – rata error 1,06 % untuk pengukuran suhu dan memiliki rata - rata error 1,77 % untuk pengukuran kelembapan udara. Sensor soil moisture memiliki rata – rata error 2.53 % untuk mengukur kelembapan tanah. Hasil pengujian diketahui bahwa kondisi greenhouse menggunakan sistem kendali memiliki suhu rata-rata pada pagi hari yaitu 28,02 °C, pada siang hari yaitu 33,03 °C, dan pada malam hari yaitu 27,82 °C. Data kelembapan udara rata – rata pada pagi hari yaitu 80,17 %, pada siang hari yaitu 67,83 %, dan pada malam hari yaitu 80,46 %. Data kelembapan tanah rata – rata yaitu 67,97 %. Tanaman stroberi yang terdapat di dalam greenhouse tumbuh lebih optimal dan menghasilkan buah dari pada tanaman stroberi yang berada di luar greenhouse yang terlihat lebih layu dan tidak menghasilkan buah. Strawberry plants are plants that can grow optimally in environmental conditions such as those in the highlands. Unfavorable environmental conditions can cause strawberry plants to grow less than optimally. Therefore, it is necessary to have a greenhouse to protect strawberry plants from unfavorable environmental conditions and the risk of pest and disease attacks. The aim of this research is to design a control system for a strawberry greenhouse. The control system in this greenhouse uses the Sugeno method of fuzzy logic controller. The DHT22 sensor test results have an average error of 1,04% for temperature measurements and average error of 1,75% for air humidity measurements. The soil moisture sensor has an average error of 2,53% for measuring soil moisture. The test results showed that the greenhouse conditions using the control system had an average temperature in the morning of 28.02 °C, in the afternoon of 33.03 °C, and in the evening of 27.82 °C. The average air humidity data in the morning is 80.17%, in the afternoon it is 67.83%, and in the evening it is 80.46%. The average soil moisture data is 67.97%. Strawberry plants in the greenhouse grow more optimally and produce more fruit than strawberry plants outside the greenhouse which look more wilted and do not produce fruit.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMPLEMENTASI FUZZY LOGIC CONTROLLER PADA SISTEM KENDALI SUHU DAN KELEMBAPAN GREENHOUSE TANAMAN STROBERI
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Fuzzy Logic Controller, Greenhouse, Tanaman Stroberi | Keywords: Fuzzy Logic Controller, Greenhouse, Strawberry Plants

Paragraf: Fokus penelitian ini adalah pengembangan prototipe untuk mendeteksi keberadaan plate dan menguji posisi plate pada mesin Rock Imager dengan menggunakan model machine learning. Deteksi keberadaan plate yang ada pada mesin Rock Imager terbatas pada mendeteksi barcode yang tertempel pada plate, yang mana jika barcode tidak terpasang maka tidak akan terdeteksi sebagai plate. Lebih dari itu tidak ada cara untuk memeriksa apakah posisi plate sudah pada posisi yang sesuai atau belum. Penelitian ini menggunakan model YOLOv7, yang merupakan salah satu model deteksi objek dibawah lingkup deep learning. Arsitektur yang dipilih pada penelitian ada dua jenis, yaitu YOLOv7-Tiny dan YOLOv7. Hasil deteksi akan digunakan untuk mengidentifikasikan plate dengan cara memberikan kondisi apakah hasil deteksi berada pada Region of Interest (ROI) yang sudah ditentukan pada empat kategori pengujian. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa baik YOLOv7-Tiny maupun YOLOv7 dapat digunakan dalam mendeteksi dan menguji posisi plate pada dataset testing sebanyak 72 buah citra menggunakan dataset training sebanyak 300 buah. Model yang dilatih menggunakan YOLOv7- Tiny menghasilkan rata-rata akurasi deteksi kelas sebesar 100,00%, akurasi uji posisi sebesar 94,45%, dan Intersection of Union (IoU) sebesar 87,40%. Model yang dilatih menggunakan YOLOv7 menghasilkan rata-rata akurasi deteksi kelas sebesar 100,00%, akurasi uji posisi sebesar 97,22%, dan IoU sebesar 88,54%.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMPLEMENTASI MACHINE LEARNING UNTUK DETEKSI KEBERADAAN DAN UJI POSISI PLATE PADA MESIN ROCK IMAGER
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Mesin Rock Imager, Plate, Region of Interest, YOLOv7, YOLOv7- Tiny

Paragraf: INTI SARI Panel surya sebagai sumber energi terbarukan yang populer, sering dihadapkan pada tantangan suhu tinggi di daerah tropis dan subtropis yang dapat mengurangi daya keluaran dan umur pakai. Dalam kondisi suhu di atas 25°C, efisiensi panel surya dapat turun 15%. Watercooling system dengan pompa air dan sensor suhu DS18B20 yang terhubung pada mikrokontroler ESP32 diusulkan sebagai solusi. Penelitian ini menitik beratkan pada peningkatan output daya yang dihasilkan oleh panel surya, dengan ESP32 menyalakan pompa air pada saat suhu permukaan panel diatas 25°C dan mematikannya dibawah suhu 25°C. Penelitian ini menganalisis pengaruh watercooling system terhadap performa panel surya dalam berbagai kondisi suhu dan cuaca. Hasil perbandingan menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan watercooling system meningkatkan output daya panel surya secara signifikan. Pada kondisi cuaca cerah, peningkatan mencapai 49,26%, sedangkan pada cuaca cerah berawan, terdapat kenaikan sebesar 38,61%. Watercooling system efektif menurunkan suhu panel surya hingga 23,54%, menjaga suhu permukaan pada 29,79°C. Aplikasi watercooling system memberikan kontribusi positif terhadap efektivitas dan kinerja panel surya, terutama dalam mengatasi tantangan suhu tinggi. Studi ini merinci pengukuran suhu, output daya, dan perbandingan hasil antara kondisi dengan dan tanpa watercooling system, membuktikan bahwa teknologi ini dapat meningkatkan produktivitas panel surya dalam menghasilkan energi terbarukan. Kata kunci – Panel Surya, Peningkatan Ouput Daya, Suhu Tinggi, Water Cooling System
Judul: SKRIPSI PERANCANGAN WATERCOOLING SYSTEM UNTUK MENINGKATKAN OUTPUT DAYA PADA PANEL SURYA

Paragraf: Peningkatan jumlah mahasiswa yang akan menempati kampus baru Universitas Tidar, Kampus Sidotopo yang beralamat di Jl. Barito 1 No.2, Kedungsari, Kec. Magelang Utara, Kota Magelang, Jawa Tengah, mengakibatkan pengguna jaringan sebagai beban jaringan Wi-Fi juga meningkat. Pengujian QoS secara real-time pada sisi end-user dilakukan untuk mengetahui kualitas kinerja jaringan yang telah dibangun. Pengujian dilakukan dari perspektif lapisan ke-7 pada model OSI dengan menjalankan layanan IPTV dan layanan download sebagai beban jaringan. Transmisi data yang berjalan pada protokol TCP dan UDP di-monitoring untuk mendapatkan data variabel parameter QoS yang menghasilkan uji trafik data pada layanan IPTV dengan parameter packet loss terkecil sebesar 6,1% dengan kategori "Bagus", throughput terbaik sebesar 2482,6 kbps dengan kategori "Sangat Bagus", parameter delay terbaik sebesar 4,0 ms dengan kategori "Sangat Bagus", serta jitter terbaik sebesar 3,9 ms dengan kategori "Bagus". Layanan download dengan nilai parameter packet loss terkecil sebesar 6,6% dengan kategori "Bagus", parameter throughput terbaik sebesar 9191,1 kbps dengan kategori "Sangat Bagus", parameter delay terbaik sebesar 1,0 ms dengan kategori "Sangat Bagus", serta jitter terbaik sebesar 1,0 ms dengan kategori "Bagus". Penilaian QoS menunjukkan peningkatan hasil nilai indeks QoS, dari rata-rata nilai indeks 3,35 pada layanan IPTV yang dikategorikan sebagai "Memuaskan", lalu pada layanan download mendapatkan nilai indeks 3,5 yang termasuk dalam kategori "Memuaskan", berdasarkan ketetapan TIPHON.
Judul: SKRIPSI QUALITY OF SERVICE (QoS) JARINGAN INTERNET Wi-Fi TERHADAP LAYANAN IPTV (INTERNET PROTOCOL TELEVISION) PADA KAMPUS SIDOTOPO UNIVERSITAS TIDAR
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : end-user, IPTV, OSI, Quality of Service, TCP, UDP

Paragraf: Insiden kebakaran masih signifikan dalam hal angka kejadiannya selama beberapa tahun terakhir, karena dapat membahayakan nyawa manusia dan merusak lingkungan. Deteksi dini kebakaran sangat penting dilakukan. Luasnya area pemantauan membuat potensi kebakaran pada beberapa titik gedung berbeda sehingga perlu adanya pemantauan spesifik untuk mengetahui titik mana yang berpotensi terjadi kebakaran. Pengembangan sistem multi telemetri berbasis komunikasi wireless dapat menjadi solusi untuk mengatasi hal tersebut. Sistem ini menggunakan tiga node sensor dengan sensor DS18B20 dan MQ2 untuk mendeteksi perubahan suhu dan konsentrasi gas sebagai indikator awal kebakaran. Data dari node-node ini dikirimkan ke base station melalui modul komunikasi radio NRF24L01. Base station dilengkapi dengan berbagai komponen seperti LCD, buzzer, dan SIM800L untuk memberikan notifikasi kepada pemadam kebakaran dan memfasilitasi evakuasi. Pengujian sistem melibatkan kalibrasi sensor suhu DS18B20, pengujian interface sistem seperti LCD, dan pengujian protokol komunikasi topologi star. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan tingkat kesalahan pengukuran sensor yang cukup rendah, kinerja LCD yang baik, dan efektivitas protokol komunikasi. Sensor suhu DS18B20 menunjukkan tingkat kesalahan pengukuran sekitar 3,21% untuk node 1, 3,61% untuk node 2, dan 3,56% untuk node 3, mengindikasikan akurasi yang relatif baik untuk aplikasi deteksi kebakaran. Namun, pengujian jarak jangkauan komunikasi menunjukkan keterbatasan, terutama dalam kondisi Non-Line of Sight (NLOS). Analisis Quality of Service (QoS) menunjukkan delay dan jitter yang tinggi, meskipun tidak ada packet loss. Kesimpulan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa sistem ini berhasil dirancang, tetapi perlu peningkatan dalam hal optimasi jarak komunikasi, manajemen QoS, dan diversifikasi sistem pemberitahuan.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERANCANGAN SISTEM MULTI TELEMETRI BERBASIS KOMUNIKASI WIRELESS UNTUK DETEKSI DINI KEBAKARAN GEDUNG
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : Arduino, Wireless, Quality of service, LoS, NLoS, Jitter, Delay

Paragraf: Dalam konteks kebutuhan tenaga medis yang terus meningkat dan jumlah pasien rawat inap di rumah sakit yang melampaui jumlah tenaga medis, terutama pada layanan perawatan 24 jam, pengawasan terhadap kondisi cairan infus pada pasien menjadi semakin menantang. Keterbatasan ini dapat mengakibatkan potensi kelalaian dalam pemantauan yang sangat penting. Biasanya, perawat harus secara manual memeriksa kondisi infus secara berkala, menghabiskan waktu yang signifikan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk merancang Alat monitoring dan kontrol infus yang digunakan untuk mengawasi dan mengontrol cairan infus pada kantong infus pasien. Sistem ini tidak hanya memantau dan mengontrol secara online, tetapi juga memberikan informasi terkait volume cairan infus pasien. Pengiriman notifikasi pada ruang perawat melalui website dan notifikasi telegram. Loadcell digunakan untuk mendeteksi berat cairan pada botol, selain itu menggunakan Sensor Speed Arduino yang digunakan sebagai pendeteksi tetesan cairan pada selang infus, serta dibagian mekanik menggunakan servo yang berfungsi sebagai pengatur laju kecepatan cairan infusnya. Ketika volume cairan kurang dari atau sama dengan 200 mL, maka akan mengirimkan notifikasi ke telegram sebagai tanda bahaya.
Judul: SKRIPSI RANCANG BANGUN SISTEM MONITORING DAN KONTROL INFUS
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : Pemantauan sistem infus, kontrol infus jarak jauh.

Paragraf: Serangan Distibuted Denial of Service (DDoS) adalah salah satu serangan siber yang cukup menjadi perhatian sejalan dengan meningkatnya teknologi informasi. Di era sekarang, DDoS merupakan suatu masalah menantang dalam mendeteksi bahkan mengurangi dampak dari serangan DDoS. Software Defined Network (SDN) merupakan salah satu arsitektur yang rentang akan serangan DDoS ini. Dengan menyediakan kontrol terpusat dalam cara kerjanya menjadikan DDoS sangat efekif digunakan dalam menyerang arsitektur SDN. Oleh karena itu, penelitian ini bertujuan untuk membuat model deteksi dini serangan DDoS pada arsitektur SDN menggunakan pendekatan algoritma machine learning. Dengan memperhatikan fitur-fitur dengan memilih fitur terpenting dengan menggunakan metode recursive feature elimination with cross validation (RFECV) terbukti dengan hanya menggunakan 23 fitur dari 83 fitur telah mendapatkan nilai cross validation tertinggi sebesar >95%. Dalam menangani kesenjangan kelas target metode synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE) dapat menjadikan performa model machine learning mengalami peningkatan pada algoritma yang diusulakan yaitu, decision tree, random forest, naïve bayes, support vector machine,dan multi-class perceptron. Dengan algoritma random forest yang memiliki confusion matrix tertinggi dengan akurasi 99,96%, presisi 100%, recall 99,99%, dan F1-score 99,99%.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMPLEMENTASI MACHINE LEARNING DALAM DETEKSI DINI SERANGAN DISTRIBUTED DENIAL OF SERVICE PADA ARSITEKTUR SOFTWARE DEFINED NETWORK
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: Distributed Denial of Service, Software Defined Network, Machine Learning, RFECV, SMOTE

Paragraf: Di tengah perkembangan teknologi digital, permintaan pasar untuk kartu RFID meningkat sehingga berdampak pada proses produksi yang terus meningkat seiring dengan meningkatnya kebutuhan manusia. Pada era industri 4.0, teknologi robot sudah maju dan dapat membantu manusia. Robot juga dapat menjalankan proses produksi secara konsisten dengan ketelitian yang tinggi. Dalam mengatasi lonjakan permintaan pasar, dilakukan perancangan sistem pengendalian kualitas menggunakan Computer Vision pada sistem produksi kartu RFID. Metode yang digunakan adalah Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) dengan algoritma YOLOv5, Untuk meningkatkan deteksi kerusakan, dataset dikumpulkan menggunakan dua kelas, yaitu Hole dan Crack. Hasil simulasi menunjukkan data rata-rata akurasi 89% ketika diterapkan pada conveyor dengan live detection, yang dapat dianggap cukup baik untuk diterapkan jika ditambahkan optimalisasi penangkapan gambar untuk meningkatkan lagi akurasi deteksi. Jumlah dataset mempengaruhi hasil dari model pelatihan, yaitu dari segi akurasi dan presisi, sehingga semakin banyak dataset yang digunakan maka semakin akurat hasil deteksi. Dengan komputer vision, proses produksi dapat berjalan lebih stabil. Computer Vision dapat diterapkan dalam proses produksi untuk mempermudah quality control.
Judul: SKRIPSI SISTEM QUALITY CONTROL BERBASIS COMPUTER VISION PADA MESIN SORTIR OTOMATIS PRODUKSI KARTU RFID
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: Convolutional Neural Network, live detection, quality control, RFID, YOLOv5.

Paragraf: Pada industri manufaktur ada beberapa aspek penting yang perlu diperhatikan agar bisa mencetak barang dengan kualitas terjamin. Salah satu aspek tersebut adalah pada proses akhir yaitu proses perakitan (assembling). Salah satu part yang melalui proses ini adalah caliper. Caliper merupakan komponen yang penting pada rem cakram guna menjepit kampas rem (pad comp) dan piston brake. Pad comp akan menekan bagian piringan cakram sehingga akan menimbulkan gesekan untuk menghentikan putaran rem cakram. Agar dapat menghentikan putaran secara maksimal, diperlukan adanya bahan peredam berupa grease dengan kualitas dan kuantitas yang tepat sesuai dengan standar masing-masing jenis pad comp. Maka dari itu, dibuatlah alat apply grease otomatis untuk meningkatkan efisiensi pemakaian grease dan volume grease pada pad comp bisa stabil sesuai dengan standarnya serta tidak ada proses apply grease ke bagian yang tidak seharusnya. Dengan adanya alat ini, diperoleh persentase efisiensi pemakaian grease untuk inner sebesar 0,5% dan untuk outer sebesar 2,55%. Selain itu, tidak ada lagi proses apply grease ke bagian yang tidak semestinya.
Judul: SKRIPSI OTOMATISASI PROSES APPLY GREASE UNTUK MENINGKATKAN EFISIENSI PEMAKAIAN GREASE LINE SUB ASSY PAD COMP
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Dispensing system, grease, pad com, PLC

Paragraf: Perencanaan fire alarm dan pemadam kebakaran pada Gedung Dekanat 7 lantai Universitas Tidar Mertoyudan dilakukan karena terdapat risiko kebakaran yang upaya penanggulangannya sulit dilakukan ketika bangunan terlalu tinggi sehingga dapat menyebabkan kerugian materiil, alam, bahkan korban jiwa. Dalam menyelesaikan perencanaan ini memerlukan beberapa tahapan yang mencakup studi literatur, pengumpulan data dan pengolahan data. Gedung Dekanat Universitas Tidar Mertoyudan merupakan bangunan 7 lantai dengan luas bangunan perlantai 512 m2. Berdasarkan hasil perhitungan yang telah dilakukan dapat disimpulkan bahwa Gedung Dekanat Universitas Tidar Mertoyudan sesuai SNI 03-3985-2000 membutuhkan detektor asap 82 unit, sesuai SNI 03-3989-2000 membutuhkan sprinkler 129unit, volume air yang dibutuhkan 232 m3, Ground Water Tank (GWT) berkapasitas 300 m3, daya pompa yang dibutuhkan yaitu daya pompa elektrik 36 kW, pompa jockey 3,6 kW, dan pompa diesel 140 HP. Berdasarkan perhitungan daya pompa, disarankan menggunakan pompa dengan daya pompa elektrik 45 kW, pompa jockey 15 kW, pompa diesel 110 kW. Biaya keseluruhan yang dibutuhkan dalam perencanaan ini sebesar Rp 998.049.000,00. Perhitungan perencanaan fire alarm dan pemadam kebakaran telah sesuai dengan peraturan dan standar diharapkan dapat meningkatkan keselamatan penghuni serta melindungi aset-aset berharga pada Gedung Dekanat Universitas Tidar Mertoyudan.
Judul: SKRIPSI PERENCANAAN FIRE ALARM DAN PEMADAM KEBAKARAN PADA GEDUNG DEKANAT 7 LANTAI UNIVERSITAS TIDAR MERTOYUDAN
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci : fire alarm, pemadam kebakaran, detektor, sprinkler

Paragraf: English is a crucial global communication tool, for students to succeed in various aspects of life. However, students often face difficulties in effectively expressing their emotions and understanding the connotations of emotive language, which is partly attributed to limited exposure of reading text of Merdeka Curriculum Textbooks. This study aims to analyze emotive language in the ""Bahasa Inggris Tingkat Lanjut"" textbook, identify the types of emotive language present, and assess their distribution. The research problem addresses the need to help student's express emotions effectively and comprehend the nuances of emotive language. In this study, the writer conducted qualitative research and utilizes the Merdeka Curriculum and the ""Bahasa Inggris Tingkat Lanjut"" textbook, focusing on the reading text. The analysis involves identifying and categorizing different types of emotive language present in the textbook based on Jakobson's (1960) theory, with a particular emphasis on their distribution. The study also provides the percentage distribution of each type of emotive language appearing in the textbook. The analysis reveals the percentage distribution of various types of emotive language in the textbook, with displeasure and worry being the most prominent (21%), surprise and hope (9.8%), like (8%), dear (6.5%), gratitude (3.2%), and want, intention, desire, dissatisfaction (1.6%). These findings provide insights into the prevalence of emotive language in the learning context. The function of emotive language which is mostly appear displeasure and worry is to convey negative emotions and reactions. The role of emotive language in the ""Bahasa Inggris Tingkat Lanjut"" Merdeka Curriculum Textbook extends to linguistic advancement, embracing emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and proficiency in communication Understanding the distribution of emotive language in textbooks has implications for curriculum development, textbook authoring, and educators. The findings highlight the importance of incorporating emotive language into learning materials to help students' express emotions and understand nuances.
Judul: SKRIPSI INVESTIGATING EMOTIVE LANGUAGE IN READING TEXT OF â€œBAHASA INGGRIS TINGKAT LANJUTâ€ MERDEKA CURRICULUM TEXTBOOK FOR 11TH GRADE SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Emotive language, English textbooks, Merdeka curriculum, reading text, senior high school students.

Paragraf: In English Language Teaching, speaking is one of the very influential skills because this skill is essential to communicating with one another. Many students need more confidence in speaking because of low pronunciation, and teachers need help improving the method and technique to make students interested in learning English speaking. Those aspects need improvement because the students need help in speaking competencies such as grammar, vocabulary, fluency, and pronunciation. After conducting the speaking competencies, students are expected to be more confident in sharing their ideas and thoughts. This study aimed to describe the significance of video projects in improving students' speaking skills and overcoming speaking problems such as less motivation, lack of self-confidence, wrong pronunciation, and grammar. The subjects were tenth-grader students in the academic year 2023/2024. A classroom action research approach was used by non-test and test collection techniques. The video project as media also included a questionnaire and results of speaking skills; the data findings were examined using the theory of Kemmis and Taggart and verified using Hughes (2003). Utilizing video projects had the benefit of improving students' speaking skills. The data on this study showed that pronunciation increased to 90 scores (63%), and grammar score increased to 99 (69%). Meanwhile, in fluency scores, it is 91 (63%). Part of vocabulary 97 scores (67%). Then, based on implementation through classroom action research, "Utilizing Video Projects to Enhance the Tenth Graders' Speaking Skills" showed that the study can enhance the speaking skills of the X8 class on SMAN 3 Temanggung in the school year 2023/2024.
Judul: SKRIPSI UTILIZING VIDEO PROJECTS TO ENHANCE THE TENTH GRADERSâ€™ SPEAKING SKILLS
Keyword_Text: Keywords: ELT in Tenth graders, video projects, speaking skills

Paragraf: Rahadyan. Fakhri Muhammad, 2024. "USING NINO'S HOME VIDEOS TO IMPROVE PROCEDURE TEXT WRITING SKILLS FOR THE NINTH GRADERS OF SMP NEGERI 3 TEMANGGUNG". A Paper. English Department. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training of Universitas Tidar. The implementation of the learning process in English subjects is done by developing the habit of reading, and writing. In writing class, the students should be able to create and share their thoughts in words. However, many students had difficulties in writing due to their lack of writing knowledge, including in writing procedure texts. The difficulties came from both internal and external factors. Internal factors are related to students' self-ability in learning, while external factors are from students' environments, such as teachers' ways of teaching or class situations. To overcome the problems, the writer conducted a research that focuses on improving students' writing skills using the "Nino's Home" videos as teaching media. The aim was to know on ""Nino's Home"" videos effect in improving the ninth graders' writing skills. This research also has a goal to find if "Nino's Home"" videos could help improve the ninth graders' motivation in writing procedure text. This research applied classroom action research, with the subject of the research being 32 students of the 9 F class from SMP Negeri 3 Temanggung. The writer used tests, observation, questionnaires, and documentation as research instruments. The research was conducted in three phases: Pre-Cycle, Cycle 1, and Cycle 2. It was conducted in four steps namely planning, acting, observing, and reflecting. The results of the research showed that the students' skills in writing procedure texts and motivation improved after being taught using "Nino's Home" In Pre-Cycle, the percentage of students' motivation was 40.04%, 61.60% in Cycle 1, and 79.72% in Cycle 2. The mean of students' writing scores in Pre-Cycle was 55.35, 70.34 in Cycle 1, and 77.81 in Cycle 2. It can be concluded that using the "Nino's Home" videos as teaching media can improve students' writing skills and students' motivation in learning Procedure Text. These media make students participate enthusiastically during the teaching–learning process.
Judul: SKRIPSI USING NINOâ€™S HOME VIDEOS TO IMPROVE PROCEDURE TEXT WRITING SKILLS FOR THE NINTH GRADERS OF SMP NEGERI 3 TEMANGGUNG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Motivation, Procedure Text, Writing.

Paragraf: Mastering listening skills is crucial for EFL learners, especially for English Department students. Appropriate learning approach is essential for students to succeed in listening learning. The Extensive Listening course at Universitas Tidar applies a Blended Learning Approach, combining face-to-face and online classes with technology assistance. This approach aims to help students adapt to new learning systems, considering the shift to face-to-face learning after the COVID-19 pandemic. However, students faced some obstacles and expressed dissatisfaction with this approach, particularly concerning their listening skills and the application of Blended Learning. Therefore, the writer focuses on investigating the students' difficulties with their listening skills, the implementation of Blended Learning in the Extensive Listening classes, and the student's perception of its implementation. This study was caried out through a qualitative method using a case study approach. The writer used questionnaires and semi-structured interviews as data collection techniques. The subject of this study was the third-semester English Education Department students who took the Extensive Listening course at Universitas Tidar in the academic year 2022/2023. The writer distributed questionnaires to 39 students and conducted interviews with six students. The writer analyzed the data using the data analysis theory proposed by Miles & Huberman (2014) and validated the data using methodological triangulation. The findings revealed that students experienced difficulties with their listening skills in the Extensive Listening class in three categories related to themselves as listeners, listening material, and the speaker and physical setting. These difficulties were caused by the teaching and learning process that did not stimulate students to be active, passive learning interactions, and students' fear of asking to the lecturer. Furthermore, the writer found that learning in the Extensive Listening classes was divided into online classes conducted with e-learning and face-to-face in the language laboratory with more interactive activities. In terms of students' perceptions, students reported the benefits of each learning mode, the challenges they encountered in Blended Learning classes, and the suggestions for quality improvement.
Judul: SKRIPSI EXPLORING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF BLENDED LEARNING APPROACH IN EXTENSIVE LISTENING COURSE (A CASE STUDY IN THE ENGLISH EDUCATION DEPARTMENT AT UNIVERSITAS TIDAR IN THE ACADEMIC YEAR 2022/2023)

Paragraf: In applying the learning model to a material, it was necessary to know whether the learning model used was effective. This would be useful for teachers to apply and provide learning that could make it easier for teachers to transfer knowledge and acknowledge from students. In this study, the writer examined whether the Example non-example learning model effectively improved students' ability to write descriptive text in tenth-grade students of MAN 1 Magelang. This research was conducted at the tenth-grade of Madrasah Aliyah Negeri (MAN) 1 Magelang. The research used quasi-experimental with a non-equivalent control group design. Then, the sample in this research was 48 students from two classes. One class contains 24 students as a control class, and the other was also 24 students as an experimental class. These data analyzed using SPSS 25 through Independent Sample t-test and One-Way ANOVA. On the findings and discussion, the mean score of experimental class in pre-test was 72,7 and in the post-test was 80,1. While, for the control class, the pre-test score was 73,5 and 75,5 for the post-test. Furthermore, the sig.(2-tailed) score in the independent sample t-test was 0.004. It showed that there was a significance difference in descriptive text writing skill between students who are taught using example non-example learning model and students who are taught using lecturing learning model. One-Way ANOVA calculations carried out in this research, the writer found that the F value calculated from the data was 13,402 and F table was 4.30. It was indicated that example non-example learning model in improving students' writing descriptive text skill. In conclusion, there was a significance difference in descriptive text writing skill between students who are taught using example non-example learning model and students who are taught using lecturing learning model and the example non-example learning model was effective in improving students' writing descriptive text skill.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE EFFECTIVENESS OF USING EXAMPLE NON-EXAMPLES LEARNING MODEL TO IMPROVE THE DESCRIPTIVE TEXT WRITING SKILL OF TENTH GRADERS OF MAN 1 MAGELANG

Paragraf: The tenth-grade students were required to master reading skills while learning English. Reading skills are very crucial to be mastered since it is a fundamental skill that could assist the students in acquiring other skills. As a foreign language, learning English, particularly reading an English text, is challenging for the students. Knowing to what extent students' English reading skills are lacking and the difficulties that may occur is essential. It can help to improve the student's and teachers' awareness about how to minimize the difficulties that the students may experience. Therefore, a good learning outcome can be achieved. The design of this study is a descriptive quantitative study. The writer used a reading test to collect the data. The reading test is constructed based on the Learning Achievement of the reading element in the Merdeka Curriculum that refers to several macro reading skills stated by Brown (2004). The writer took 53 tenth-grade students of SMA PGRI Temanggung as the population of this study. The sample of this study was determined using the total sampling technique. In other words, the writer took the entire population as the sample of this study. The first results showed that the mean score of the reading test was 54.38. Generally, the students' English reading skills were categorized at the ""Poor"" level. In addition, the study also showed that the students faced difficulties in all of the reading skills indicators. Infer context that is not explicit is the indicator with the most contributed difficulties at 14.6%. Vocabulary is the second indicator that contributed to difficulties at 14.07%. Reference is the third contributed difficulties at 13.5%. Implied information is the fourth contributed difficulties at 13.3%. Infer links and connections between events is the fifth contributed difficulties at 12.6%. Deduce causes and effects is the sixth contributed difficulties at 9.7%. Rhetorical Form (generic structure) is the seventh contributed difficulties at 7.36%. Main idea is the eighth contributed difficulties at 6.82%. Author's purposes/communicative function of the text is the ninth contributed difficulties at 5.0%. Explicit information is the last indicator that has the slightest difficulties, at 2.6%.
Judul: SKRIPSI INVESTIGATING ENGLISH READING SKILLS OF THE TENTH GRADE STUDENTS OF SMA PGRI TEMANGGUNG
Keyword_Text: Keywords : reading skills, students' difficulties

Paragraf: English is an International language that requires students to be able to communicate in English. Speaking is one of the fundamental skills that must be considered in learning English based on the Merdeka Curriculum. However, developing speaking skills is complex. The students must be highly motivated and actively engaged in the classroom speaking activities. Therefore, the teachers must be able to provide good learning media that can manage students' interest during the learning process. The objective of the study is t o reveal whether the students who are taught using the Digital Storytelling as learning medium have better speaking skill than those who are taught using textbooks and its measurement of improvement. The study employed the quasi - experimental research desi gn with the purposive random sampling technique. The sample was 71 tenth - grade students from two classes. The experimental group was XL with 36 students and XK as the control group contains 35 students. The experimental group was taught using the Digital Storytelling as learning media and the control group was using the textbooks. The data of pre - test and post - test were analyzed using the t - test. After analyzing the data, Independent t - test result was lower than 0.05 (Sig. (2 - tailed) .000 < 0.05). It showed that there is a difference significancy between the experimental and the control groups in terms of speaking skill. The post - test means score comparison between the experimental and the control group were also pointed out that the experimental gr oup had better scores in the post - test than the control group (87.06 > 81.09). According to the elaboration, the writer briefly summarized that the Digital Storytelling could be an effective media to improve speaking skill of the tenth - grade students. Th is learning media is helpful for the teacher to attract students' attention and increase their speaking fluency during the teaching - learning process.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE EFFECTIVENESS OF USING DIGITAL STORYTELLING IN TEACHING NARRATIVE TEXT TO IMPROVE SPEAKING SKILL OF THE TENTH-GRADE STUDENTS AT MAN TEMANGGUNG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Digital Storytelling, Narrative Text, Speaking Skill

Paragraf: Nugraheni, Annisrina Fajri. (2023). The Correlation between Vocabulary Mastery and Writing Skills of Ninth Graders of SMP Negeri 1 Bandongan. A Paper. Magelang: English Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. 1, 2, Four language skills are needed to master a language: listening, reading, speaking, and writing. To communicate in written form, two aspects are needed: vocabulary mastery and writing skills. Someone needs writing skills and extensive vocabulary knowledge to create good writing. Even so, it was found that there were still students who had difficulties in translating words both from Indonesian to English and vice versa, difficulties in using the right words, and difficulties in constructing sentences in English. In addition, some students still have limited knowledge in vocabulary. This study focused on finding the students' vocabulary mastery level, the students' writing skills level, and the correlation between vocabulary mastery and writing skills. A person will master four language skills, including writing, easier if they have a broad vocabulary. The more comprehensive the vocabulary knowledge, the more vocabulary will be used in writing; hence, the vocabulary used in the writing will be more varied. Correlation research was used in this study. The population of the study were 9th graders of SMP Negeri 1 Bandongan, and the sample were 29 students from class 9B at SMP Negeri 1 Bandongan. The instruments of the study were vocabulary test and writing test. The instruments were derived from previous researches. The data taken was analyzed using a correlation test with SPSS. The results of this study show no significant correlation between vocabulary mastery and writing skills with the Sig value. (2-tailed) 0.145 > 0.05. Furthermore, the correlation coefficient is 0.278. Hence, the correlation between vocabulary mastery and writing skills was low. This study suggests that teachers and students focus not only on learning and mastering vocabulary but also on other aspects that influence writing ability and the writing itself.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE CORRELATION BETWEEN THE VOCABULARY MASTERY AND WRITING SKILLS OF THE NINTH GRADERS OF SMP NEGERI 1 BANDONGAN
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Vocabulary Mastery, Writing Skills, Correlational Study

Paragraf: Reading is one of the English skills that students must master. However, sometimes, they still have difficulty understanding the content and topic discussed in the text. Some students of tenth graders in SMA N 1 Dukun have difficulties understanding the clause complex that form a text because they are lack vocabulary and unfamiliar with the English text. In 2017, the Ministry of Education and Culture of Indonesia launched an English textbook for tenth graders entitled Bahasa Inggris, which contains several reading texts. Therefore, the writer interested in analyzing the clause complex relation exist in reading text of the textbook as the data research. The research objectives are to determine the type of clause complex found and the dominant clause complex used in the textbook Bahasa Inggris. The aims analyzing the clause complex is to find out the complexity level of the reading text within textbook seen by the data finding of the clause complex. Then, this study implemented qualitative discourse analysis to analyze the data. The data were taken from the 13 examples of reading texts in the textbook. The writer collected the data through documentation. The data were analyzed by classifying the clause and identifying the clause complex, focusing on the logico-semantic relation according to the theory of Halliday and Matthiessan (2014). Data analysis reveals 227 logico-semantic relations, including expansion and projection. In general, the most frequent logico semantic found is expansion which appears in 182 times (80.18 %). Then in specific there are expansion extension, which appears 69 times (30.40 %). Followed by expansion enhancement that occurred 60 times (26.43 %), and expansion elaboration in 53 times (23.35 %). Next, the projection found 33 times (14.54 %) for locution and 12 times (5.29 %) for idea. Based on the result of the study, it can be concluded that the reading text in the textbook contains all the types of logico semantic relations, though not every text contains all the logico semantic types completely. From this research, teachers are supported in developing learning materials related to teaching reading by the pedagogical implications of this study. In addition, the clause complex relation also helps the students understand the content of the text by looking at the connection between clauses.

Keyword_Text: Keywords: Reading, Clause Complex, Textbook

Paragraf: Cindyanti, Gracea Ayu. 2023."Classroom Management Problems in Teaching English at SMK N 3 Magelang in Post Covid-19 Pandemic Era". Undergraduated Thesis. English Department. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Tidar University. Supervisor 1 C. Prima Ferry K., M.Pd., Supervisor 2 The classroom management system underwent a significant revision due to the Covid-19 outbreak, especially in the teaching and learning process in the 2022-2023 school year in the post Corona Virus Disease Pandemic due to the enactment of the Joint Decree of the Council of Ministers of Education and Culture.Teachers must quickly learn new health protocols. To teach English in post Covid-19, teachers must change their classroom management strategies.English teachers also identified several new problems with implementing face-to-face learning in post the Covid-19 pandemic. Poor classroom management causes low student learning outcomes. The study aims to describe how English teachers manage their classrooms when teaching English and to find out the problems that English teachers have regarding classroom management when teaching English. The research used descriptive qualitative research method. The research instruments used are interviews and observation. The subjects of this study are three SMK N 3 Magelang teachers. The findings show that there are several strategies used by teachers to manage English classes. There are seating arrangements, arranging learning activities, choosing exciting topics, and disciplining students with rigid rules. Teachers also found several classroom management problemsthere are lack of vocabulary, low student motivation, mother language disorders, student boredom, dependence on mobile phones, less effective study hours, and a shortage of classrooms.In implementing learning, the teacher needed help with classroom management. The problems found in classroom management can help predict things that will be encountered in teaching English.
Judul: SKRIPSI CLASSROOM MANAGEMENT PROBLEMS IN TEACHING ENGLISH AT SMK N 3 MAGELANG IN POST COVID-19 PANDEMIC ERA

Paragraf: Ariyani, Rizki Silvia (2023): The Impact of Self-Monitoring Strategy on Students' Narrative Text Speaking Skill of The Eighth Grader in SMPN 4 Magelang. A Paper, English Education Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I: : The pandemic forced students to study from home, leading to a lack of direct interaction with teachers. When students returned to school, teachers had to start guiding them from scratch. Different teaching strategies were used, including discussion and lecturing to engage students, and self-monitoring to help students assess their progress and make plans to overcome challenges. These strategies have their own benefits and differ in terms of focus, goals, and methods. After the pandemic, students at SMPN 4 Magelang faced difficulties in English speaking skill due to a lack of opportunities for practice and companionship when students had to do online learning, which led them to feel nervous, not confident, afraid, and even stutter when they have to read and spoke in English. Therefore, the writer was interested in using a self-monitoring strategy to know the impact on students' narrative text-speaking skill. A quasi-experimental design was used in the study. The writer employed a Nonequivalent (Pretest and Post-test) Design with a purposive sampling technique. Both groups were given pretests and post-tests; the experimental group was the only one to receive the treatment, while the control group was instructed using conventional techniques, including lectures and discussions. Then, the data was observed using an independent T-Test using the SPSS 22 version. The study found no significant difference in the impact of the self-monitoring strategy on eighth-grade students' narrative text-speaking skill at SMPN 4 Magelang. However, the average score increased by 20%, from 61.75 in pretest to 82.21 in post-test, indicating an impact on students' scores. Moreover, a self-monitoring strategy has a positive impact, such as making students more confident and less nervous about speaking in English, reducing fear of judgment, and making mistakes. Thus, the use of self-monitoring strategies positively impacts students' narrative text speaking skill. The writer expected that other researchers interested in applying a self-monitoring technique to evaluating speaking skill across numerous academic fields would be able to build on and use this study.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE IMPACT OF SELF-MONITORING STRATEGY ON STUDENTS' NARRATIVE TEXT SPEAKING SKILL OF THE EIGHTH GRADER IN SMPN 4 MAGELANG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Self-Monitoring, Speaking Fluency, Teaching Strategy

Paragraf: Writing is one of the English skills which is hard to learn by the students. Especially, in writing a recount text, the students find difficulties to transfer their ideas into written form and they still have lack of vocabulary. The use of proper media can increase the students' writing ability and learning motivation. In addition, it helps the students to solve their difficulties in writing. The objectives of this study were (1) to find out the use of Board Game towards the junior high school students' ability to write a recount text in the ninth grade of SMP Negeri 3 Magelang, and (2) to find out the use of Board Game towards the students' learning motivation in the ninth grade of SMP Negeri 3 Magelang. The writer conducted Classroom Action Research (CAR) which was divided into Pre-Cycle, Cycle I, and Cycle II. The participants of this study consisted of 32 students, 8 males and 24 females, in IX F class of SMP Negeri 3 Magelang. The data were collected through observation, questionnaire, documentation, and tests. To analyze the data, the writer divided into two based on the results namely test data and non-test data. The test data were analyzed within numeric analysis, but the non-test data were analyzed descriptively. The results of this study showed that most of the students enhanced their ability to write a recount text. The average score in pre-cycle was 65.38, the average score in cycle I was 74.71, and the average score in cycle II was 82.38. There were only eight students of 32 students who did not pass the standard minimum score. It meant that the students had reached more than 75%. The writer compared the observation and questionnaire results in the pre-cycle, cycle I, and cycle II to find out the enhancement of students' learning motivation. In the pre-cycle, the average of students' learning motivation was 57.50, in the cycle I, it was 69.06, and the average of students' learning motivation in cycle II was 80.63. It meant that the students had reached more than 75%. Then, it indicated that the students were motivated to write a recount text with a Board Game. Therefore, the use of Board Game could enhance students' ability and their learning motivation in writing a recount text.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE USE OF BOARD GAME TO ENHANCE STUDENTSâ€™ ABILITY IN WRITING A RECOUNT TEXT FOR NINTH GRADE OF SMP NEGERI 3 MAGELANG IN THE ACADEMIC YEAR OF 2023/2024
Keyword_Text: Keywords: writing, recount text, Board Game

Paragraf: Darmawan, Nugroho. (2023). The effectiveness of dictogloss technique to improve listening comprehension of report text in senior high school. An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I Rini Estiyowati Ikaningrum.,M.Pd., II Listening is one of the essential English language skills that students need to master. To understand what others are saying, students must comprehend every word and the topic being discussed. Unfortunately, students often struggle with listening due to their limited participation in the teaching and learning process. Therefore, teachers need to employ creative teaching techniques to enhance student engagement. One such technique is the dictogloss. In this study, writer implemented the dictogloss technique to improve students' listening comprehension of report text in high school education. This study aimed to achieve two objectives. First, to determine whether the dictogloss technique effectively improves students' listening comprehension. The second objective is to assess the significance of the improvement in students' listening skills after the technique is implemented. The writer conducted a study involving eleventh-grade students at SMAN 1 Mertoyudan, which had 31 students in a randomly chosen class. The writer used Pre-Experimental research design in this study that contains three stages: a pre-test, a teaching intervention, and a post-test. The writer used pre-test and post-test data collection to assess students' listening comprehension before and after learning dictogloss. The data analysis was performed using SPSS. The results showed a significant improvement in students' engagement in the report text listening class after the writer implemented dictogloss as the teaching technique. The pre-test and post-test results were analyzed using SPSS, which revealed a Sig (2-tailed) score of 0.0. According to the rule for establishing a significant difference between the pre-test and post-test, if the Sig (2-tailed) score is below 0.05, as indicated by the SPSS calculation, it signifies a significant difference before and after the implementation of the dictogloss technique. In conclusion, this research about dictogloss is effective in enhancing students' listening comprehension in report text. The writer also suggests to use dictogloss technique in teaching listening especially in listening comprehension.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE EFFECTIVENESS OF DICTOGLOSS TECHNIQUE TO IMPROVE LISTENING COMPREHENSHION OF REPORT TEXT IN THE SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL UNDERGRADUATE THESIS
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Listening, report text, dictogloss

Paragraf: Pratiwi, Rosa Sangga. (2023). The Use of Speedy English Grammar Application to Improve Students' Grammar Mastery at the Seventh Grade of SMP N 12 Magelang. An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I Speedy English Grammar application is a media for learning grammar because this application can help students to master grammar with fun especially in the seventh grade. Related to the case, this study implemented the Speedy English Grammar application to improve the students' grammar mastery in Junior School Education. Meanwhile, this study only focuses on the simple present tense as the novelty. The objectives are to find out the improvement of students' grammar mastery and motivation after Speedy English Grammar application was implemented in grammar class on simple present tense. The writer conducted Classroom Action Research (CAR) consisting of some stages: Pre-Cycle, Cycle I, and Cycle II. The study focused on VII-B students at SMP N 12 Magelang, chosen due to having the lowest average scores among classes. The data collection techniques that were used were tests and non-tests. The tests were administered in Pre-Cycle, Cycle I, and Cycle II containing 20 items (10 completion tests and 10 true or false). The non-test techniques included observations, questionnaires, interviews, and documentation. Then, the data were analyzed by qualitative and quantitative techniques. The qualitative analysis followed Miles and Huberman's (1994) three-step process: data reduction, data display, and conclusion. Meanwhile the quantitative analysis assessed average scores in each test by Arikunto's (2010). The writer also used methodological triangulation to get the data validity. The result of this study showed that the implemented the Speedy English Grammar application can improve students' motivation for grammar mastery. The results of observation, questionnaire, interview, and documentation proved it. The result of observation in Pre-Cycle was 53.45%, increasing to 81.03% in Cycle I and 91.03% in Cycle II. The implementation of the Speedy English Grammar application also made improvements in grammar mastery. In the Pre-Cycle test, the average grammar mastery score was 69.83. After the Speedy English Grammar application was applied, the average of student's score in Cycle I test reached 79.83, and it improved to 86.55 on the Cycle II test. Therefore, there was 16.72% points of the total improvement from the Pre-Cycle and Cycle II tests. Based on the results above, the writer concludes that using the Speedy English Grammar application could improve the students' motivation and grammar mastery. Hence, it is recommended that English teachers apply the Speedy English Grammar application as an alternative media for teaching grammar.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE USE OF SPEEDY ENGLISH GRAMMAR APPLICATION TO IMPROVE STUDENTSâ€™ GRAMMAR MASTERY AT THE SEVENTH GRADE OF SMP N 12 MAGELANG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Speedy English Grammar, grammar mastery, simple tense

Paragraf: In writing an announcement text, the text cannot be separated from the language features. It is important for the students to understand the language features used in the announcement text. Language features that are used in announcement text can help the students to write a good announcement text. This research focuses on language features of students' writing in announcement text written by the tenth grader of SMKN 2 Buduran. The objective of the study is to describe the language feature of the students' writing on announcement text and to analyze the result of students' writing on announcement text fulfilled the language features of announcement text. The method of research used in this research was descriptive qualitative. The research subject of this study was the thirty-four students' announcement text of the X-RPL of SMKN 2 Buduran in 2022/2023. The data collection was carried out using documentation. The research showed twenty-six students used simple present tense, seventeen students used simple future tense, thirteen students used proper nouns, fourteen students used imperative sentences, and thirty-two students used declarative sentences. Based on the results, it can be concluded that the students understanding on using the language features in announcement text should be improved. Therefore, the students can write a better announcement text. There are five language features on announcement text: simple present tense, simple future tense, proper noun, imperative sentence, and declarative sentence. Overall, almost all of the tenth-grader students understand how to write an announcement text. However, the students need to improve in using simple future tense, proper nouns, and imperative sentences.
Judul: SKRIPSI AN ANALYSIS OF LANGUAGE FEATURES OF STUDENTSâ€™ WRITING ON ANNOUNCEMENT TEXT OF TENTH GRADERS OF SMKN 2 BUDURAN
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Announcement Text, Language Features, Writing

Paragraf: The purpose of this study is: (1) to investigate blended learning implemented by English teachers at MTsN 2 Kota Magelang during post Covid-19 Pandemic in the academic year of 2022/2023. (2) To investigate the problems faced by English teachers at MTsN 2 Kota Magelang in implementing blended learning. This research used descriptive qualitative research. The participants of this study were two English teachers at MTsN 2 Kota Magelang and 32 students of MTsN 2 Kota Magelang. Interviews were used to collect data from teachers and questionnaire were used to collect data from students. The data were analyzed and interpreted through qualitative procedures. In implementing blended learning, it is divided into two classes, namely face-to-face and online classes. The results of interview on two English teachers of MTsN 2 Kota Magelang show that they found some problems in implementing blended learning. The Problems found in the implementation of blended learning in face-to-face classes included; learning time being too short, while the problems faced in online learning such as; low internet connection, limited internet data, and fewer students owning smartphones. To solve problems of offline learning, the teachers taught as well as possible in class, then students could ask about material and practice questions via Whatsapp. The solution for problems of online learning, online assessments or assignments were sent to students' home by school couriers, who were subject teachers or school officials. The results of questionnaire on 32 students of MTsN 2 Kota Magelang show a positive response from students. Students are interested in learning using the blended learning method with the online application, this method has benefits for students. This can be seen from students' questionnaire answers if the teacher uses the blended learning method in learning English. Students easily collect assignments and can motivate students to explore related content. Blended learning could be a relevant model to teach English in post Covid-19 pandemic.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE IMPLEMENTATION OF BLENDED LEARNING BY ENGLISH TEACHERS AT MTSN 2 KOTA MAGELANG IN POST COVID-19 PANDEMIC
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Blended Learning, Teaching English, Post Covid-19

Paragraf: Writing skill is important in language learning to avoid misunderstandings. The students encountered some difficulties during writing class, including low vocabulary and incorrect grammar.
