Judul: SKRIPSI IMPROVING THE STUDENTSâ€™ WRITING SKILL IN HORTATORY EXPOSITION TEXT THROUGH PROBLEM BASED LEARNING
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Writing, Hortatory Exposition Text, Problem-Based Learning Writing is one of six language skills in the recent curriculum that students should master besides speaking, listening, reading, viewing, and presenting. Based on the observation, this skill was difficult enough to be learned by eleventh graders of SMAN 1 Grabag. Most students still had low vocabulary mastery and found difficulties writing English texts. The average score for writing skills can also prove it was under the standard minimum score, which was 75. According to the eleventh-grade English class teacher, the writer found that many students had difficulty improving their writing skills and how they should start writing a text. They also had trouble finding motivation and interest in writing a text. Hence, some eleventh-grade students had difficulty expressing their ideas in the written material of a text they wanted to write. Thus, the study aimed to know whether the implementation of problem-based learning can have a discernible influence on enhancing learning motivation in acquiring writing skill in Hortatory exposition text. This study was conducted using classroom action research (CAR). Cycle I, Cycle II, and Pre-Cycle were categories. The XI F-2 of SMAN 1 Grabag was used as the research subject during the 2023–2024 academic year. There were 36 students in total. The writer used tests and non-tests to get the data. The writer analyzed data using quantitative methods. The research shows students' motivation to learn English has significantly increased. From Pre-Cycle to Cycle II, the non-test's overall improvement progressively rose by 34% points. The students were eager to learn how to write better and find more information about the text. The Pre-Cycle test had an average score of 50. It fits into the category of the fair. The Cycle I test had an average score of 68, whereas the Cycle II test had an average score of 77. Consequently, there was a 27-point increase in the Pre-Cycle to Cycle II score. It entails successfully enhancing students' writing abilities in hortatory exposition texts through problembased learning method. The writer suggest for another researcher could further develop this study with different aspects or learning material and a broader scope in future studies.

Paragraf: Salsabila, Hanifati Husna. (2024). Investigating Lexical Cohesion in Descriptive Reading Text Found in an English Textbook for Tenth Graders. An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Department. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I Dr. Dwi Winarsih., M.Pd, II
Judul: SKRIPSI INVESTIGATING LEXICAL COHESION IN DESCRIPTIVE READING TEXT FOUND IN AN ENGLISH TEXTBOOK FOR TENTH GRADERS
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Descriptive Reading Text, English Textbook, Lexical Cohesion, Tenth Grades This research delves into the investigation of lexical cohesion within descriptive reading texts featured in an English textbook tailored for tenth-grade students. The study offers valuable insights into the efficacy of cohesive devices within the realm of educational materials, thereby contributing to the enhancement of curriculum development and instructional practices for tenth-grade students. The objectives of this research are to identify the types of lexical cohesion used in the reading text of the tenth graders English textbook and to find out the dominant type of lexical cohesion used in the reading text of the tenth graders English textbook. This research used qualitative method. To gain the data, the writer used documentation. The data were collected from the Kemendikud catalouge book taken from the official website of Pusat Kurikulum dan perbukuan Balitbang Kemendikbud. The data were analyzed based on theory of lexical cohession by Halliday and Hassan (1997). The analysis centers on the presence and impact of lexical cohesion, encompassing five distinct categories—Repetition, Synonym or Near-Synonym, General Word, Superordinate, and Collocation. Notably, all five types of lexical cohesion were identified in each reading text, with a total of 158 occurrences throughout the tenth-grade English textbook. Of these occurrences, Repetition emerged as the most prevalent form, accounting for 48 instances, followed by Superordinate (38), Collocation (36), Synonym or Near-Synonym (27), and General Word (10). Drawing from the research findings, specific recommendations are provided to enhance reading comprehension and fluency through targeted lexical cohesive devices. Ultimately, the research aims to bolster students' overall language proficiency, enabling them to effectively comprehend and engage with descriptive reading texts at the tenth-grade level. This study holds significance for educators and curriculum developers, offering practical insights into optimizing educational materials and fostering better language learning experiences for students.

Paragraf: Reading comprehension is a skill to comprehend a written text that has been read by using the reader's prior knowledge and experience. Reading comprehension is one of the fundamental skills in the Merdeka Curriculum. In Merdeka Curriculum, students must be able to comprehend variety of texts. This study focused on the narrative text since this text contains a story that is suitable with the learning strategy. Students have to find the main ideas, specific details, author's purpose, and implicit information. In fact, the majority students in Indonesia still struggle in comprehending a text. As a future teacher, the writer needs to know the suitable learning strategy to achieve the learning goal. The story-wheel strategy can be the learning strategy for students in learning reading comprehension by visualizing a written text into concrete images. With concrete images, students can be more engaged with the text and have a better understanding than they have to memorize a long text. This study wants to determine whether there is a significant difference in students' reading comprehension of narrative text between those who were using the story-wheel strategy and those who were using the summarizing strategy at SMA Sholihin Bandongan in the academic year 2023/2024. This study employed a quasi-experimental approach using a pre-test-post- test control group design. This study was conducted in two classes, the experimental class and the control class. The population was drawn from the 10th graders of SMA Sholihin Bandongan in the academic year 2023/2024, which included 83 students. The sample of this study was 25 students from each class, selected using a cluster random sampling technique. The data collection was gathered from a reading test. Then, the writer examined the data using the SPSS V22. The result revealed that there is the difference in the students' mean scores between the two groups. The mean score for the experimental class was 78.8, whereas the mean score for the control class was 72.4. The result of the T-test revealed that there is a significant difference between those two groups. The value of ttest was higher than ttable (2.073> 2.000). In conclusion, there is a significant difference in students' reading comprehension using the story-wheel strategy and the summarizing strategy. This strategy had a good impact on 10th graders' reading comprehension, particularly in narrative text, at SMA Sholihin Bandongan in the academic year 2023/2024.

Paragraf: Based on the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Indonesia Number 25 regulation of 2022, textbooks were books prepared for learning based on national education standards and the applicable curriculum. In the teaching and learning process, apart from using textbooks from the Ministry of Education, English teachers at MAN 1 Kabupaten Magelang developed and replicated textbooks as books to support learning materials entitled ""Modul Pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris"" for grades ten, eleven, and twelve. These textbooks contain various types of text, and several suffixed words are in the reading text, making it difficult for students to understand the text. The students still have difficulty understanding the meaning of complex or unfamiliar words because of low vocabulary and lack of knowledge of suffixes, especially derivational suffixes that can change the meaning and parts of speech. This study aims to identify derivational suffixes' types, functions, and meanings in texts in English textbook.The study analyzes the derivational suffixes in texts in textbook using a qualitative approach and content analysis method. The data was from texts based on genres that learned in senior high school expecially texts in English textbook for the 11th grade entitled 'Modul Pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris' used by MAN 1 Kabupaten Magelang. The writer collected the data through documentation within the textbooks and got nineteen texts based on genres, there were four texts of invitation text, six texts of analytical exposition text, one text of report text, and the last was eight texts of explanation text that to be analyzed and identified in this study. The writer analyzed data results based on Plag's theory (2003) combined with Katamba's theory (1993). And the function of derivational suffixes based on Lieber's theory (2009). Based on the result of this study, the total number of derivational affixes in the English text in students' textbooks was 104, verbal suffixes, which appeared 1 time; nominal suffixes, which appeared 47 times; adverbial suffixes, which appeared 26 times; and adjectival suffixes, which appeared 30 times. The second was the function of derivational suffixes that consisted of category-changing lexeme formation, which occurred 18 times, meaning-changing lexeme formation, which occurred 8 times, and both categories and meaning-changing lexeme formation, which occurred 78 times. Then, for the meanings of derivational suffixes 103 items of data were found to have meaning and were analyzed based on the theory of Plag (2003) and Katamba (1993). Only one word that has meaning is not based on the theory used in this study

Paragraf: The low ability of students to read report text was the starting point for this research. This happened due to various factors. There are several ways to improve the students' reading skills, with the teacher's role in delivering material to the students as one of the essential aspects of the learning strategy. Thus, a study was required to determine the effectiveness of a team-based flipped learning strategy that can improve students' reading skills in the reports. The aims of this study were: a) to know the significant difference of students' reading skill between those who are taught by team-based flipped learning and those who are taught by small group discussion; b) to know the effectiveness of team-based flipped learning in improving tenth-grade students' reading skills. The research method used was a Quasi-experimental design. The population of this study were the tenth graders of SMK N 2 Magelang in the school year 2023/2024. The total number of students is 396, with 36 students in each class. The sample was class X AKL A and X AKL B. The total number of students is 72. The researcher used tests to collect data. The researcher used an independent sample t-test and N-Gain to analyze the data. The results of this study were as follows: 1) Based on the independent sample, t-test results show a significant difference between the team-based flipped learning strategy and small group discussion strategy. The result showed that the significance (2-tailed) was 0.021, which is lower than 0.05 (0.021 < 0.05). It means there was a significant difference in students' reading skills between those taught by team-based flipped learning and those taught by small group discussion. The alternative hypothesis (Ha) was also accepted. 2) The effectiveness of using the team-based flipped learning strategy was calculated using N-Gain. The results show that the presentation value of N gain in the experimental class was 62.849, which is quite effective. Additionally, the researcher invites future researcher to explore research on teaching strategy, precisely the team-based flipped learning strategy, to expand available references in the field. The researcher suggests that teachers may use team-based flipped learning as a learning strategy because of the many advantages that can be considered. In addition, other researcher can develop this study with different aspects or learning materials and a wider scope in the future.

Paragraf: This study is motivated by several problems. Currently, there are many real cases among students that do not reflect the characters of Pancasila student Profile. On the other hand, students also have difficulty comprehending explanation reading texts. In addition, there is also an urgency to maximize the use of smartphones in to support the teaching and learning process. Considering some problems above, this study has three objectives. The first objective is to describe the need for Javanese local wisdom themed based reading materials through android-based learning media for teaching explanation text in Merdeka Curriculum. The second objective is to explain the design and development of the product. The third objective is to elucidates the feasibility of the product. To fulfill the objectives mentioned, this study uses Design and Development Research (DDR) as the methodology. In particular, this study belongs to product and tool research by also emphasizing the specific project phases. This specific project consists of three phases, namely analyze, design and develop, and evaluation. The analyzing phase shows that more sociocultural explanation text reading materials are highly needed by the subjects, especially those related to local wisdom. The subjects also need interactive learning media, such as application. Consequently, the designing and developing phase produces material draft, application flowchart, storyboard, and an application prototype called Xplanity. Finally, this product enters the evaluating phase where it is validated by experts. The reading materials packaged in android-based learning media in the form of an application called Xplanity is considered feasible and worthy to be used. In using the product later, it is suggested that teacher can spark all students' interest in reading the materials developed. Apart from that, the students' focus and distraction when reading the materials through the application also need to be paid attention.

Paragraf: Reading is a crucial skill that students must acquire when studying English. While the textbook comprises multiple texts, students might need help to comprehend narrative texts that employ figurative language with non-literal meanings. Though there are various types of figurative language, students are generally acquainted with only a few of them. Therefore, the writer conducted a study to overcome the problem by doing a semantic analysis of figurative language in narrative text for reading skills on the Merdeka curriculum textbook for the eleventh graders. The study has three objectives: the first is to analyse the types of figurative language found, the second is to find out the dominant figurative language types, and the third is to find out the functions of figurative language types used in the reading skill narrative text of the Merdeka curriculum English textbook. This study used descriptive qualitative research to present and analyse the data findings. The subject of this study is an English textbook for the eleventh graders using the Merdeka curriculum entitled ""Bahasa Inggris Tingkat Lanjut."" The instrument of this study is a document, a guideline adapted from ""Perrine's Literature: Structure, Sounds & Sense,"" published in 2018. There were four steps to collecting the data: reading, identification, classification, and simplification. The units of analysis were five selected narrative texts to improve students' reading skills. The writer used data analysis techniques: condensation, display, and drawing and verifying conclusions. The analysis of the five chosen narrative texts showed that they contain 21 figurative languages, which can be divided into eight types. The most frequently used figurative language is a symbol, which appears eight times, followed by personification, which appears five times. Synecdoche and overstatement appear twice each in the selected narrative texts. Comparatively, the least frequently used figurative languages in the selected narrative texts are simile, apostrophe, irony, and metonymy, which only appear once each in the selected narrative texts. There are three functions of figurative language: it allows the reader to enjoy imaginative pleasure and brings additional imagery into the text, adds emotional intensity to the literary text, and says much in a brief compass. This study aims to improve students' reading and critical thinking skills by teaching them to understand figurative language in narratives, offering insights for educators and serving as a model for similar studies.
Judul: SKRIPSI A SEMANTIC ANALYSIS OF FIGURATIVE LANGUAGE IN NARRATIVE TEXT READING SKILL ON THE MERDEKA CURRICULUM TEXTBOOK FOR THE ELEVENTH GRADERS
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Figurative Language, Narrative Text, Semantic Analysis, Textbook

Paragraf: Wardhani, Lintang Rizki. 2024. "The Relationship among The Students' Reading Habit, Reading Strategy, and Reading Comprehension at SMP Negeri 9 Magelang". An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I Reading is an important skill because reading can add a lot of information and experience. So when reading, readers need to understand the text or content, not only know the words. Thus, reading habits are required so that reading comprehension can increase Apart from having a reading habit, students must also understand how to use reading strategies appropriately to improve their reading comprehension. Recount text is material taught in school. Reading recount text allows students to have new experiences, add information, use it as entertainment, and increase reading comprehension. This study aims to find out the relationship between the students' reading habits and reading comprehension, the relationship between the students' reading strategy and reading comprehension, and to find out the relationship among the students' reading habits, reading strategy, and reading comprehension at SMP N 9 Magelang. This research used quantitative methods with correlation design analysis. The correlation test used Pearson product moment and multiple correlations in SPSS 26. The data collection technique used is a questionnaire and test. The population of this study was a class VIII student at SMP 9 Magelang, with a sample of 62 students. The result of this study is that there is a relationship between reading habits and reading comprehension, as shown in Sig. (2-tailed) of 0.000 and a coefficient of 0.622 or in the high category, there is a relationship between reading strategies and reading comprehension, as indicated by Sig. (2-tailed) of 0.000 and a coefficient of 0.722 or in the high category, and a relationship exists among reading habits, reading strategies, and reading comprehension, as shown in Sig. F changes of 0.000 and R-Value of 0.756 or in the high category. Based on the findings above, there is a significant relationship between reading habits and reading comprehension, a significant relationship between reading strategy and reading comprehension, and a significant relationship among reading habits, reading strategies, and reading comprehension. As for the suggestion, teachers can motivate students to read, provide homework with clear instructions, and give feedback to students with an explanation of the appropriate use of the reading strategy.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE RELATIONSHIP AMONG THE STUDENTSâ€™ READING HABIT, READING STRATEGY, AND READING COMPREHENSION AT SMP NEGERI 9 MAGELANG

Paragraf: Subroto, F. K. H. (2024). "The Effectiveness of Using Liveworksheets on Students' Reading Skill of Narrative Text at MAN Temanggung". An Undergraduate Thesis. English Department, Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I Reading skills are very important for learning and acquiring knowledge. However, many tenth-grade students at MAN Temanggung face challenges in understanding English texts due to low vocabulary levels and lack of interest. Students struggle with basic vocabulary and comprehension, making learning difficult. Traditional methods used are less stimulating, resulting in passivity and disinterest. Therefore, it is necessary to use technology in learning to create a more engaging classroom atmosphere, such as LiveWorksheets. The objectives of this study were to know whether there is any significant difference between those who are taught by using LiveWorksheets and those who are taught using paper-based worksheets on students' reading skill and to know the students' perceive of using LiveWorksheets in improving students' reading skill. This research was quasi-experimental. The subjects were students in tenth grade MAN Temanggung. It used purposive sampling consisting of a control class and an experimental class. Each class consisted of 36 students. The techniques used to collect data were test and non-test. Test data were obtained from pretest and posttest scores, while non-test data were obtained from questionnaires. The test data were analyzed using SPSS, and the non-test data were analyzed using descriptive quantitative methods. According to the data analysis, there is a significant difference between the average reading skill scores of students taught using LiveWorksheets and those taught using paper-based worksheets. The results of the Independent Sample T-test show a significance value (2-tailed) of 0.032, which is smaller than the significance level of 0.05. Students' perceptions of LiveWorksheets are very positive. This is evidenced by the level of use of LiveWorksheets as an assessment, which was rated 90.73%. The benefits of LiveWorksheets in readings were rated 93.05%. Additionally, 88.88% of students strongly disagreed that LiveWorksheets has significant weaknesses. Overall, the results show a very high level of approval at 91.55%. Therefore, the use of LiveWorksheets is effective in improving students' narrative text reading skills. Most students agree that LiveWorksheets is an effective and useful tool for reading skills, and they do not perceive any significant drawbacks in its use. Additionally, the researcher recommends that English teachers use LiveWorksheets to teach reading because of its many advantages.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE EFFECTIVENESS OF USING LIVEWORKSHEETS ON STUDENTSâ€™ READING SKILL OF NARRATIVE TEXT AT MAN TEMANGGUNG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: LiveWorksheets, Reading Skill, Narrative Text

Paragraf: Ussolichah, Ana Nisa. 2024. "Code-Switching Used in English Teacher Talks in Teaching Learning Process at MAN Kota Magelang in The School Year of 2023/2024". An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Department. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training. Universitas Tidar. 1 Dr. 2 Code-switching is one of the strategies commonly used by English teachers in the teaching and learning process. Likewise, in grade XII IPA 2 of MAN Kota Magelang, teachers also use code-switching when teaching English classes. English teacher uses two languages in grade XII IPA 2, namely English and Indonesian. This is due to students' lack of vocabulary and knowledge in English, which causes students to find it difficult to understand the material if the teacher teaches in full English. Apart from that, the mindset that English is difficult makes students' interest in learning English decrease because they always think that English is difficult. Therefore, the writer was interested in researching code-switching used in English teacher talks in the teaching-learning process at grade 12 IPA 2 of MAN Kota Magelang. The purpose of this study is to identify the types, functions and students' perspectives regarding the use of code-switching used by English teacher in the teaching and learning process. The data in this study were analyzed using descriptive qualitative methods. The subjects of this study were English teacher and students of XII IPA 2 of MAN Kota Magelang in the school year 2023/2024. Observation, audiovisual material, interviews, and questionnaires are the techniques used by the writer to collect data in this study. The writer uses Poplack's theory to analyze types of code-switching, Mattson and Burenhutt's theory to analyze the function of code-switching, and Mukhsen's theory to analyze students' perspectives on the use of code-switching used by teachers in teaching. This study discovered 78 code-switchings carried out by English teacher in the teaching and learning process in grade XII IPA 2. There were three types, namely inter-sentential switching with 33 data (42%), intra-sentential switching with 39 data (50% ), and extra-sentential switching with 6 data (8%). Apart from that, there are three functions of code-switching, namely topic switch with 41 data (53%), affective function with 21 data (27%), and repetitive function with 16 data (20%). Furthermore, a positive perspective was obtained from students regarding the use of code switching by English teacher in the teaching and learning process viii because this makes it easier for students to understand the material or instructions given by the teacher. As a result, there were three types and functions of code-switching used by English teacher during the teaching and learning process. The most dominant type of code-switching used by English teacher is Intra-sentential switching, and the most dominant function of code-switching used by the English teacher is the topic switch function. Apart from that, the students have a positive perspective regarding the use of code-switching in English teacher talks during the teaching and learning process because the students feel helped by the code-switching used by teachers in teaching. The code-switching used by English teachers in teaching can make it easier for students to understand the material and instructions given by the teacher.
Judul: SKRIPSI CODE-SWITCHING USED IN ENGLISH TEACHER TALKS IN TEACHING LEARNING PROCESS AT MAN KOTA MAGELANG IN THE SCHOOL YEAR OF 2023/2024

Paragraf: Sofiriyah, Nurul Muna. 2024. "The Effectiveness of the Use of Direct Corrective Feedback to Improve The Writing Skills of the Eighth Graders at SMP N 9 Magelang". Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Study Program. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. 1 Writing is an important skill that students must master in learning English. It is the ability to take ideas and information and present them in a good writing format to be read. Based on the researcher's observation at SMP N 9 Magelang, some students had problems in the English learning process, especially in writing. They found it difficult to develop their writing skills due to the lack of feedback given on their writing assignments. One alternative solution to overcome the problem is by providing direct corrective feedback. Based on the problems faced by some students of SMP N 9 Magelang, this study aimed to investigate the effectiveness of direct corrective feedback in improving the writing ability of eighth graders at SMP N 9 Magelang. This study used a quasi-experimental design with pre-test and post-tests for the control group and experimental group. The sample consisted of students from two classes, 27 students from the experimental class and 28 students from the control class selected through the purposive sampling technique. The collected data were analyzed using SPSS 22 through normality test, homogeneity test, independent sample t-test, and N-gain test. Based on the findings of the total calculation of the study, it could be concluded that the mean score of the experimental class increased by 31.00 points, from 48.30 to 79.30. While the mean score of the control class increased by 17.29 points, from 52.71 to 70.00. Furthermore, the Sig. value of the t-test (0.000) showed that there was a significant difference in students' writing ability after the direct corrective feedback treatment was applied. The N-gain results also showed that the treatment given was effective enough to improve students' writing skills. This can be seen from the statistical score (59.6343) which falls into the moderately effective category. The study concluded that direct corrective feedback was moderately effective for improving students' writing abilities. Furthermore, the study highlights the importance of implementing structured and consistent feedback mechanisms in the classroom to facilitate better learning outcomes. Recommendations for teachers include adopting direct corrective feedback practices to provide clear and immediate guidance to students, thereby improving their writing proficiency.
Judul: SKRIPSI THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE USE OF DIRECT CORRECTIVE FEEDBACK TO IMPROVE THE WRITING SKILLS OF THE EIGHTH GRADERS AT SMP N 9 MAGELANG
Keyword_Text: Keywords: Direct Corrective Feedback, Writing Skills, Narrative Text

Paragraf: Mulyani, Sri (2024). An Analysis of Teachers' Speech Act Behaviors in EFL Learning Activity Through Sociolinguistic Perspectives. An Undergraduate Thesis. English Education Departement. Faculty of Education and Teacher Training, Universitas Tidar. I
Judul: SKRIPSI An Analysis of Teachersâ€™ Speech Act Behaviors in EFL Learning Activity Through Sociolinguistic Perspectives
Keyword_Text: Keywords: EFL Learning, Speech Act, Sociolinguistics, Teachers UtterancesIn EFL learning, teachers face challenges in using appropriate speech acts to communicate with students due to differences in social and cultural contexts. This research aims to know the kinds of speech acts found in the teacher's utterances while teaching and how teachers' sociolinguistics aspect affects speech act behaviors in the teaching process. This study adopts Austin's (1962) speech act theory, which includes verdictives, commissives, behabitives, expositives, and exercitives to understand the types and functions of speech acts in teachers' utterances during learning. In addition, this study also uses sociolinguistic theory involving aspects of cultural background, power relations, language register, and politeness strategies to analyze the linguistic interaction between teachers and students.This research uses classroom discourse analysis as the primary approach to analyzing the data that has been obtained. After identifying and classifying speech acts, the data is further analyzed by considering sociolinguistic aspects. The results of this sociolinguistic analysis are expected to provide a more comprehensive insight into communication dynamics in an educational setting.The results of this study show the frequency and percentage of speech acts used by teachers in two different contexts, TM (Teacher Mandatory Subject) and TE (Teacher Enrichment Subject). The speech act Exercitives was used most frequently, with a total of 56 times (51%), consisting of 32 times (54.3%) in TM and 24 times (47%) in TE. Furthermore, Expositives were used 31 times (28%), consisting of 12 times (20.3%) in TM and 19 times (37.3%) in TE. Verdictives appeared 11 times (10%), all in the context of TM. The speech act Behabitives is used nine times (8%), with three times (5%) in TM and six times (12%) in TE. The last is that Commissives appeared the least, namely three times (3%), consisting of 1 time (1.7%) in TM and two times (4%) in TE. The total number of speech acts identified in this study is 110 times. For the sociolinguistics context, teacher utterances convey the power relation aspect as the most frequent aspect used.

Paragraf: Pranata, Gigih Bayu. (2024). "Implementasi Kurikulum Merdeka Pada Pembelajarana Bahasa Indonesia di SMA Negeri 1 Mertoyudan". Skripsi. Program Studi Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi Kurikulum Merdeka baik itu tahap perencanaan dan pelaksanaan sesuai dengan tahapan implementasi Kurikulum Merdeka di satuan pendidikan yaitu tahap berkembang di SMA Negeri 1 Mertoyudan. Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Pembelajaran Berbasis Masalah, Pemecahan masalah, dan Berpikir Kritis,Kemampuan pemecahan masalah dan berpikir kritis ialah kemampuan yang harus dimiliki oleh siswa, maka dari itu siswa akan terbiasa mengatasi permasalahan yang ada pada kehidupan. Rumusan masalah pada penelitian ini adalah bagaimana struktur kepribadian dan mekanisme pertahanan tokoh-tokoh di dalam novel Leiden. Objek penelitian yaitu struktur kepribadian dan mekanisme pertahanan tokoh-tokoh dalam novel Leiden yang dianalisis menggunakan teori Sigmund Freud. Wujud data berupa kata, frasa, kalimat atau narasi yang menggambarkan struktur kepribadian dan mekanisme pertahanan tokoh-tokoh di dalam novel Leiden. Sumber data dan teknik penyediaan data yang digunakan close reading dengan teknik baca dan catat. Metode analisis menggunakan deskripsi analisis dan analisis isi. Hasil analisis ditemukan tokoh Rhea didominasi oleh represi sehingga memiliki karakter yang tenang dan terkendali, Skala didominasi oleh agresi sehingga memiliki karakter emosional, Atlas didominasi oleh rasionalisasi sehingga memiliki karakter rasional, dan Faizan hanya memiliki satu mekanisme pertahanan berupa rasionalisasi sehingga memiliki karakter logis, tetapi kurang fleksibel. Paragraf: Latar belakang penelitian berjudul Analisis Unsur Intrinsik dalam Novel Semua Ikan di langit karya Ziggy Zezsyazeoviennazabrizkie dan Implementasinya sebagai Modul Ajar pada Materi Teks Fantasi Kelas VII SMP adalah peminat novel bergenre fantasi yang cukup banyak di Indonesia. Salah satu novel bergenre fantasi di Indonesia adalah novel karya Ziggy Zezsyazeoviennazabrizkie yang berjudul Semua Ikan di Langit. Novel tersebut sangat relevan untuk dijadikan referensi bahan ajar teks fantasi karena memenuhi aspek karya fantasi serta menggunakan gaya bahasa yang di atas rata-rata sehingga mampu menambah wawasan siswa tentang literasi. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan fakta cerita, sarana sastra, dan tema dalam novel Semua Ikan di Langit karya Ziggy Zezsyazeoviennazabrizkie. Teori strukturalisme Robert Stanton merupakan teori yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini. Data penelitian diperoleh dari sumber tertulis dengan metode close reading. Teknik yang digunakan adalah teknik baca dan catat. Dalam proses analisis data unsur intrinsik berdasarkan teori struktural Robert Stanton di novel Semua Ikan di langit, metode yang digunakan adalah metode deskripsi analisis. Temuan yang dihadirkan dalam penelitian ini adalah ditemukan data sejumlah 198 data, dengan perincian sebagai berikut. Data fakta cerita sebanyak 136 data, sedangkan data sarana sastra sebanyak 62 data. Berdasarkan analisis yang dilakukan terhadap data fakta cerita dan sarana sastra, tema yang didapat adalah gambaran cara kehidupan berawal, berlangsung, dan berakhir berdasarkan kaca mata anak-anak. Di dalam imajinasi anak-anak sesuatu hal yang dianggap tidak mungkin oleh orang dewasa merupakan sesuatu yang mungkin saja terjadi. Pernyataan tersebut telah memenuhi aspek-aspek yang mendasari teks fantasi.
Judul: SKRIPSI ANALISIS UNSUR INTRINSIK NOVEL SEMUA IKAN DI LANGIT KARYA ZIGGY ZEZSYAZEOVIENNAZABRIZKIE DAN IMPLEMENTASINYA SEBAGAI MODUL AJAR PADA MATERI TEKS FANTASI KELAS VII SMP
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: unsur intrinsik, strukturalisme, teks fantasi.

Judul: SKRIPSI PENERAPAN MODEL PEMBELAJARAN INQUIRYCREATIVE-PROCESS (ICP) DALAM MENINGKATKAN KREATIVITAS ILMIAH SISWA
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci : Model Pembelajaran, Inquiry Creative Process (ICP), Kreativitas IlmiahKreativitas ilmiah siswa saat ini belum mendapatkan perhatian lebih dalam proses pembelajaran IPA. Proses pembelajaran sains seringkali monoton sehingga hasil belajar siswa tidak lagi memberikan pengaruh yang signifikan terhadap kemampuan berpikirnya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui apakah model pembelajaran Inquiry Creative Process (ICP) mampu meningkatkan kreativitas ilmiah siswa.Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah quasi experimental dengan tipe nonequivalent control group design. Penelitian ini berlokasi di SMPN 2 Secang dengan menggunakan dua kelas yaitu kelas VIIC sebagai kelas kontrol dan kelas VIID sebagai kelas eksperimen. Pengujian kreativitas ilmiah dilakukan dengan menggunakan 7 butir soal uraian.Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penerapan model pembelajaran inquiry creative process (ICP) terbukti mampu meningkatkan kreativitas ilmiah siswa. Hal ini terlihat dari hasil nilai uji independent sample t-test yang mendapatkan nilai Sig. sebesar 0,000 yang artinya terdapat perbedaan yang signifikan dalam tes kreativitas ilmiah secara statistik. Hal tersebut dapat terjadi karena pembelajaran dengan model ICP mampu mengarahkan siswa untuk memecahkan masalah secara kreatif sehingga berpengaruh positif terhadap kreativitas ilmiah siswa. Hasil uji N Gain pada kelas eksperimen diperoleh nilai sebesar 0,60 sedangkan kelas kontrol 0,28. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa model pembelajaran ICP memberikan dampak yang lebih besar dalam peningkatan kreativitas ilmiah siswa.

Paragraf: Rokhimah, Eka. 2024. "Pengembangan Bahan Ajar Menulis Teks Prosedur Bermuatan Kearifan Lokal untuk Siswa Kelas VII SMP". Skripsi. Program Studi Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan Universitas Tidar. Pembimbing I Penelitian yang berjudul "Pengembangan Bahan Ajar Menulis Teks Prosedur Bermuatan Kearifan Lokal untuk Siswa Kelas VII SMP" ini dilatarbelakangi oleh hasil observasi awal selama pelaksanaan kegiatan PLP II di SMP Negeri 13 Magelang. Hasil observasi menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan bahan ajar di sekolah masih berfokus pada buku teks terbitan pemerintah. Terbatasnya sumber belajar yang digunakan oleh siswa dalam proses pembelajaran menjadi salah satu penyebab siswa kesulitan memahami materi dan menyusun teks prosedur. Oleh sebab itu, perlu dikembangkan sebuah bahan ajar menulis teks prosedur yang bermuatan kearifan lokal sebagai bahan ajar pendamping buku teks terbitan pemerintah. Kearifan lokal yang dimuat ke dalam bahan ajar akan memudahkan siswa dalam memahami dan menyusun sebuah teks prosedur secara mandiri. Hal ini disebabkan pembelajaran yang bermuatan kearifan lokal memanfaatkan keadaan yang terdapat di lingkungan sekitar siswa. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk (1) memperoleh deskripsi analisis kondisi bahan ajar menulis teks prosedur pada buku teks terbitan pemerintah, (2) memperoleh deskripsi analisis kebutuhan pengembangan bahan ajar menulis teks prosedur bermuatan kearifan lokal untuk siswa kelas VII SMP di Kota Magelang, dan (3) menghasilkan bahan ajar menulis teks prosedur bermuatan kearifan lokal untuk siswa kelas VII SMP di Kota Magelang. Penelitian ini menggunakan model penelitian pengembangan atau Research and Development menurut Sugiyono. Tahapan dalam penelitian ini meliputi analisis potensi dan masalah, pengumpulan data, desain produk, dan validasi desain. Teknik pengumpulan data melalui studi kepustakaan, wawancara, angket/ kuesioner kebutuhan, dan angket/ kuesioner penilaian oleh ahli. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa (1) kondisi bahan ajar yang digunakan masih terbatas hanya menggunakan buku cetak/ buku teks terbitan pemerintah, (2) dibutuhkan bahan ajar tambahan pada materi menulis teks prosedur yang bermuatan kearifan lokal sebagai bahan ajar pendamping buku cetak/ buku teks terbitan pemerintah, (3) menghasilkan bahan ajar menulis teks prosedur bermuatan kearifan lokal dalam bentuk modul pembelajaran yang memperoleh penilaian dari ahli materi dengan persentase sebesar 97,91% dengan kategori "sangat layak" serta dari ahli media memperoleh persentase sebesar 84,37% dengan kategori "sangat layak", sehingga dapat disimpulkan bahwa modul pembelajaran yang dihasilkan sangat layak untuk digunakan dalam kegiatan pembelajaran.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGEMBANGAN BAHAN AJAR MENULIS TEKS PROSEDUR BERMUATAN KEARIFAN LOKAL UNTUK SISWA KELAS VII SMP
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: bahan ajar, kearifan lokal, modul pembelajaran, teks prosedur

Paragraf: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh beberapa alasan. Pertama, pesan yang disampaikan oleh antartokoh dalam naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL karya Iwan Simatupang disampaikan secara implisit sehingga mempunyai maksud tersembunyi dan mengandung implikatur. Kedua, naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL karya Iwan Simatupang tercipta dari ia menyaksikan perjalanan sejarah Indonesia yang memperlihatkan keadaan kemiskinan serta tidak konsistennya keamanan negara sehingga mengandung banyak implikatur yang bisa dibahas, Ketiga, tuturan yang diimplisitkan pada naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL karya Iwan Simatupang dapat menambah inovasi modul ajar teks drama kelas XI SMA. Penelitian ini bertujuan (1) Mendeskripsikan jenis implikatur dalam naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL karya Iwan Simatupang, (2) Mendeskripsikan fungsi implikatur pada naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL karya Iwan Simatupang. Objek penelitian ini ialah jenis serta fungsi implikatur dalam naskah darma RT NOL RW NOL. Teknik pada penelitian ini yakni metode simak serta teknik catat. Teknik dasar yang digunakan Pilah Unsur Penentu (PUP), dan teknik lanjutan hubungan banding menyamakan (HBS). Hasil temuan penelitian yang terdapat dalam naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL ditemukan 20 data dengan jenis implikatur konvensional 1 data dengan fungsi memberitahu. Implikatur nonkonvensional/percakapan 19 data dengan fungsi implikatur melarang 2 data, implikatur fungsi mengeluh 1 data, implikatur fungsi menyatakan 3 data, implikatur fungsi menentang 1 data, implikatur fungsi menyindir 7 data, implikatur fungsi menyarankan 1 data, implikatur fungsi menuduh 1 data, implikatur fungsi memohon 1 data, dan implikatur fungsi memutuskan 2 data. Implikatur percakapan lebih banyak ditemukan daripada implikatur konvensional. Hasil penelitian ini dapat di implementasikan menjadi modul ajar teks drama kelas XI SMA.
Judul: SKRIPSI IMPLIKATUR DALAM NASKAH DRAMA RT NOL RW NOL KARYA IWAN SIMATUPANG DAN IMPLEMENTASINYA SEBAGAI MODUL AJAR TEKS DRAMA KELAS XI SMA
Keyword_Text: Kata kunci: Fungsi implikatur, implikatur konvensional, implikatur percakapan, naskah drama RT NOL RW NOL.

Paragraf: Level 1 dengan Menggunakan Media Gambar". Program Studi Pendidikan Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia. Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan. Universitas Tidar. Pembimbing I Prof. Dr. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memformula materi ajar kosakata dengan topik jual beli BIPA Level 1. Materi ajar menggunakan media gambar. Sumber data penelitian ini ialah Standar Kompetensi lulusan (SKL) Kursus dan Pelatihan BIPA dan Kurikulum Kursus dan Pelatihan BIPA. Data penelitian ini berwujud konstruk inti-isi Standar Kompetensi Lulusan (SKL) dan Kurikulum BIPA. Data disediakan dengan metode baca dengan teknik catat. Peneliti membaca Standar Kompetensi Lulusan (SKL) Kursus dan Pelatihan BIPA dan kurikulum BIPA dan mencatat inti isinya menjadi konstruk. Konstruk dan kisi-kisi materi ajar dianalisis dengan menggunakan metode hubung. Metode ini menghubungkan isi konstruk dengan isi kisi-kisi. Metode hubung ini dilakukan dengan menggunakan teknik analisis jabar, yaitu kisi-kisi dijabarkan menjadi materi ajar kosakata topik jual beli BIPA Level 1 dengan menggunakan media gambar. Keabsahan materi ajar dilakukan dengan teknik triangulasi oleh guru atau pegiat BIPA, yaitu dinyatakan layak digunakan untuk penelitian dengan revisi oleh guru atau pegiat BIPA. Hasil penelitian ini ialah materi ajar yang mencakupi: 1) kosakata kata ganti persona dalam konstruksi kalimat, contoh kegiatan dari materi ajar ini, yaitu pelajar BIPA menerapkan kosakata yang tepat dalam konstruksi kalimat, contoh: "Aku makan rendang di (....)". 2) kosakata tawar menawar dalam konstruksi kalimat, contoh kegiatannya, pelajar BIPA melengkapi kalimat rumpang dalam percakapan tawar menawar, contoh: "Harganya.....per porsi, Pak". Uji coba materi ajar ini mendapatkan hasil bahwa keempat pelajar BIPA dikatakan telah mampu menggunakan kosakata jual beli dan tawar menawar dengan baik. Penggunaan media gambar terbukti efektif dalam meningkatkan pemerolehan dan keterampilan menggunakan kosakata pelajar BIPA Level 1.

Paragraf: Nisa, Ulfa Kholifatun (2024) "Penerapan Modul Dalam Pembelajaran Inkuiri Terbimbing Untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Berpikir Kritis dan Hasil Belajar" Skripsi. Program Studi Pendidikan Ilmu Pengetahun Alam Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan Universitas Tidar. Pembimbing I -21 merupakan abad dimana dunia akan mengalami perubahan yang pesat dalam segala aspek kehidupan. Pembelajaran abad 21 siswa dilatih untuk memiliki keterampilan yang akan berguna bagi masa depan. Keterampilan abad 21 atau keterampilan 4C yang didalamnya salah satunya keterampilan berpikir kritis, keterampilan ini merupakan keterampilan yang hendak di capai dan tercantum pada kurikulum 2013. Akan tetapi, berdasarkan studi pendahuluan yang telah dilakukan diketahui bahwa kemampuan berpikir kritis siswa kelas VIII masih tergolong rendah dengan hasil belajar masih banyak dibawah KKM.Penelitian ini merupakan penelitian quasi experimental design dengan bentuk desain nonequivalent control group design. Subjek penelitian ini adalah siswa kelas VIII sampel yang digunakan sebanyak 42 siswa yang diperoleh melalui teknik random sampling. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan dengan teknik tes tertulis, dimana instrumen tes yang digunakan berupa soal uraian untuk kemampuan berpikir kritis dan soal pilihan ganda untuk hasil belajar. Teknik analisis data yang digunakan adalah uji prasyarat, analisis peningkatan keterampilan berpikir kritis dan hasil belajar, uji Mann Whitney U Test dan uji N-Gain.Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa nilai signifikansi kemampuan berpikir kritis dan hasil belajar sebesar 0,000 yang mengindikasikan terdapat peningkatan kemampuan berpikir kritis dan hasil belajar menggunakan modul dalam pembelajaran inkuiri terbimbing. Uji N-Gain kemampuan berpikir kritis menunjukkan pada kelas eksperimen sebesar 0,65 dengan kategori sedang dan kelas kontrol sebesar 0,32 dengan kategori sedang. Hasil belajar pada kelas eksperimen sebesar 0,57 dan kelas kontrol sebesar 0,18 dengan kategori rendah. Pada kelas yang menggunakan modul dalam pembelajaran inkuiri terbimbing mengalami peningkatan. Berdasarkan hasil tersebut dapat disimpulkan bahwa terdapat peningkatan kemampuan berpikir kritis dan hasil belajar menggunakan modul dalam pembelajaran inkuiri terbimbing.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENERAPAN MODUL DALAM PEMBELAJARAN INKUIRI TERBIMBING UNTUK MENINGKATKAN KEMAMPUAN BERPIKIR KRITIS DAN HASIL BELAJAR
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: Modul, Pembelajaran Inkuiri Terbimbing, Kemampuan Bepikir Kritis, Hasil Belajar

Paragraf: Handayani, Isti. 2024. "Pengembangan Model Pembelajaran Mencipta Puisi dengan Metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan Media Pembelajaran Jenga untuk Siswa Kelas VIII SMP". Skripsi. Program Studi Pendidikan Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia. Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan. Universitas Tidar. Pembimbing I Dr. Berdasarkan survei awal di SMP Negeri 4 Magelang, 18 dari 32 siswa masih menunjukkan hasil kurang maksimal dalam menulis puisi. Hal tersebut terlihat dari nilai yang diperoleh siswa belum memenuhi Kriteria Ketercapaian Tujuan Pembelajaran (KKTP), yaitu 75. Selain itu, model, metode, dan media pembelajaran yang digunakan kurang menarik minat siswa untuk memperoleh ide. Oleh karena itu, untuk mengatasi permasalahan tersebut adalah dengan mengembangkan model pembelajaran yang menyesuaikan kebutuhan pengembangan menurut persepsi siswa dan guru, yaitu model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga. Tujuan penelitian, yaitu (1) memperoleh deskripsi kebutuhan pengembangan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga untuk siswa kelas VIII SMP. (2) memperoleh prinsip-prinsip pengembangan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga untuk siswa kelas VIII SMP. (3) mengembangkan prototipe berupa buku panduan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) beserta media pembelajaran Jenga. Metode penelitian ini adalah Research and Development (R&D) oleh Dick and Carry dengan menyesuaikan kondisi saat penelitian dan kebutuhan pengembangan guru serta siswa sehingga langkah penelitian menjadi ADD, yaitu Analysis, Design, Development. Teknik pengumpulan data berupa studi kepustakaan, wawancara, penyebaran angket kuesioner kebutuhan pengembangan model pembelajaran, serta angket uji kelayakan oleh ahli. Teknik analisis data berupa deskriptif kualitatif dan kuantitatif. Penelitian ini menghasilkan beberapa hal, yaitu sebagai berikut: (1) dibutuhkan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga. (2) Menghasilkan prinsipprinsip pengembangan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga untuk siswa kelas VIII SMP. (3) Menghasilkan prototipe desain berupa buku panduan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) beserta media pembelajaran Jenga. Hasil uji kelayakan untuk buku panduan model pembelajaran mencipta puisi sebesar 3,76 dan ahli materi sebesar 3,8 terkategori layak dengan sebagian revisi. Simpulan dari penelitian ini, yaitu prototipe model pembelajaran mencipta puisi dengan metode Think Talk Write (TTW) menggunakan media pembelajaran Jenga layak dan dapat digunakan guru sebagai alternatif dalam pembelajaran mencipta puisi. Dengan memakai model pembelajaran tersebut diharapkan siswa menjadi lebih tertarik untuk mencipta puisi dan pembelajaran terasa lebih menyenangkan. Saran untuk peneliti selanjutnya dapat melakukan penelitian dengan tujuan untuk mengetahui keefektifan model pembelajaran yang telah dikembangkan.
Judul: SKRIPSI PENGEMBANGAN MODEL PEMBELAJARAN MENCIPTA PUISI DENGAN METODE THINK TALK WRITE (TTW) MENGGUNAKAN MEDIA PEMBELAJARAN JENGA UNTUK SISWA KELAS VIII SMP
Keyword_Text: Kata Kunci: media Jenga, mencipta, metode Think Talk Write (TTW), model pembelajaran, puisi.

Paragraf: Dwizesharita, Aghata. 2024. "Jenis Tindak Tutur Perlokusi dalam Iklan di Youtube dan Implementasinya sebagai Bahan Ajar Teks Iklan di SMP". Skripsi. Program Studi Pendidikan Bahasa dan Sastra Indonesia. Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan, Universitas Tidar. Pembimbing I Dr. Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh fenomena kebahasaan, yaitu ditemukan adanya tindak tutur perlokusi dalam iklan di Youtube. Desain penelitian yang digunakan, yaitu deskriptif kualitatif. Teknik pengumpulan data menggunakan metode simak dengan teknik catat. Teknik analisis data menggunakan metode padan pragmatis dengan teknik pilah unsur penentu (PUP) dan dilanjutkan dengan teknik lanjutan, yaitu hubung banding menyamakan (HBS). Sumber data penelitian ini, yaitu iklan di Youtube. Data penelitian berwujud tuturan antarbintang iklan yang mengandung jenis tindak tutur perlokusi. Data penelitian yang diperoleh dalam iklan di Youtube, yaitu ditemukan 35 data yang terdiri atas: (1) dua data tindak tutur deklarasi dengan variasi maksud memutuskan (2) tindak tutur representatif dengan variasi maksud menyatakan satu data, enam data dengan variasi maksud memberitahu, dan empat data dengan variasi maksud menegaskan (3) tindak tutur ekspresif dengan variasi maksud memuji tiga data, mengeluh lima data, dan kegembiraan dua data (4) tindak tutur perlokusi direktif dengan variasi maksud ajakan tiga data, permohonan satu data, pemberian saran empat data, dan perintah tiga data, tindak tutur komisif dengan variasi maksud penolakan satu data. Berdasarkan hasil penelitian terkait jenis tindak tutur perlokusi dalam iklan di Youtube dapat dijadikan alternatif tambahan materi teks iklan di SMP.
Judul: SKRIPSI JENIS TINDAK TUTUR PERLOKUSI DALAM IKLAN DI YOUTUBE DAN IMPLEMENTASINYA SEBAGAI BAHAN AJAR TEKS IKLAN DI SMP
